grapes.origin: 历史栽培集中于 Marche 与亚得里亚海中部，Arquata del Tronto 是重要地点。
grapes.summary: 早熟而酸度高、结构扎实；是 Offida 单品种白酒的重要葡萄。
grapes.viticulture: 萌芽中等、成熟早；生长势中低，产量中等且有波动；适合温暖温带及微钙质黏土。
grapes.winemaking: 适合静态、起泡及可陈年白酒；VCR417 可用于桶陈。
grapes.taste: 酸度高，结构坚实，鲜果及香料；VCR417 呈苹果与花香。
grapes.confusions: 与 Passerina 相比通常成熟更早、产量较低；二者是栽培特征对照，并非异名。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Historically cultivated in Marche and the central Adriatic; Arquata del Tronto is a reference locality.
text.zh: 历史栽培集中于 Marche 与亚得里亚海中部，Arquata del Tronto 是重要地点。

text.en: Medium budbreak; early maturity. Medium-low vigour, moderate and sometimes irregular yields; suits warm-temperate sites and slightly calcareous clay.
text.zh: 萌芽中等、成熟早；生长势中低，产量中等且有波动；适合温暖温带及微钙质黏土。

text.en: Still, sparkling and ageworthy white styles; VCR417 can support barrel maturation.
text.zh: 适合静态、起泡及可陈年白酒；VCR417 可用于桶陈。

text.en: High acidity, firm structure, fresh fruit and spice; VCR417 shows apple and flowers.
text.zh: 酸度高，结构坚实，鲜果及香料；VCR417 呈苹果与花香。

text.en: Small to medium berries with thin skin of medium consistency.
text.zh: 果粒中小，果皮薄而质地中等。

text.en: Medium-long pruning is preferred; spur cordon is possible, particularly with VCR417.
text.zh: 偏好中长梢修剪，尤其 VCR417 也可采用短梢水平主干。

grapes.origin: 亚得里亚海中部品种，确切起源未定，在 Marche 与 Abruzzo 栽培。
grapes.summary: 生长势强、成熟晚，可用于单酿静态及起泡白酒。
grapes.viticulture: 萌芽中晚、成熟晚；高产且稳定，果串和果粒大、皮厚坚韧。
grapes.winemaking: 适合较长且留芽量多的修剪；VCR6 可酿起泡及混酿静态酒。
grapes.taste: 通常干型、口感充实且酸度良好；克隆表现可由草本至果香与香料。
grapes.confusions: 果串形态与 Trebbiano Toscano 相近，但形态相似不能确定遗传同一性。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: A central Adriatic variety of uncertain precise origin, cultivated in Marche and Abruzzo.
text.zh: 亚得里亚海中部品种，确切起源未定，在 Marche 与 Abruzzo 栽培。

text.en: Mid-late budbreak and late ripening; high, consistent production. Large bunches and berries with thick, resistant skins.
text.zh: 萌芽中晚、成熟晚；高产且稳定，果串和果粒大、皮厚坚韧。

text.en: Long, generous pruning suits its vigour; VCR6 is used for sparkling and blended still wines.
text.zh: 适合较长且留芽量多的修剪；VCR6 可酿起泡及混酿静态酒。

text.en: Generally full and dry with useful acidity; clone expression varies from herbal to fruit and spice.
text.zh: 通常干型、口感充实且酸度良好；克隆表现可由草本至果香与香料。

text.en: Mid-late budbreak reduces exposure to early spring cold.
text.zh: 中晚萌芽降低早春低温暴露。

text.en: VCR450 has more golden colour, fruit-spice notes and a bitter finish; VCR6 emphasizes acidity.
text.zh: VCR450 偏金黄色、果香与香料并带微苦收尾；VCR6 更突出酸度。

grapes.origin: 意大利中部与 Orvieto 紧密相连的品种，本档案专指 Orvieto 类型。
grapes.summary: 可单酿或混酿，为酒体提供酸度及苹果、梨风味。
grapes.viticulture: 萌芽、成熟、生长势均中等，产量稳定；果串紧密，适合较重的丘陵土壤，包括轻钙质地。
grapes.winemaking: 宜中长梢修剪，可单酿或混酿以增加细致果香。
grapes.taste: 酸度良好、苹果梨香细致，常呈带绿调的黄色。
grapes.confusions: Grechetto Gentile／Grechetto di Todi 是 Pignoletto；裸词 Grechetto 存在歧义。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Central Italian variety associated with Orvieto; this dossier follows the Orvieto identity.
text.zh: 意大利中部与 Orvieto 紧密相连的品种，本档案专指 Orvieto 类型。

text.en: Medium budbreak, maturity, vigour and consistent yields; compact bunches. Suits heavier hill soils, including mildly calcareous sites.
text.zh: 萌芽、成熟、生长势均中等，产量稳定；果串紧密，适合较重的丘陵土壤，包括轻钙质地。

text.en: Medium-long pruning; fruit can be vinified alone or blended for aromatic finesse.
text.zh: 宜中长梢修剪，可单酿或混酿以增加细致果香。

text.en: Good acidity, delicate apple and pear aromas, often greenish yellow colour.
text.zh: 酸度良好、苹果梨香细致，常呈带绿调的黄色。

text.en: Susceptible to Botrytis; less sensitive to downy and powdery mildew in the VCR description.
text.zh: VCR 描述其易受灰霉影响，对霜霉及白粉病相对较不敏感。

text.en: The VCR sheet explicitly separates Orvieto from the Todi/Pignoletto identity.
text.zh: VCR 技术资料明确区分 Orvieto 与 Todi／Pignoletto 身份。

grapes.origin: 集中于 Macerata，也见于邻近 Ancona 和 Ascoli Piceno。
grapes.summary: 当地称 Ribona，是 Colli Maceratesi 的重要白葡萄。
grapes.viticulture: 萌芽与成熟中晚，生长势强、高产稳定，果串紧密。
grapes.winemaking: 用于白葡萄酒，良好酸度及花香支持当地单品种风格。
grapes.taste: 花香、柑橘及鲜果；VCR481 另有芳香草本。
grapes.confusions: Ribona 是其名称；历史希腊起源说法不能充当亲缘证明。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Centred on Macerata, with cultivation in adjoining Ancona and Ascoli Piceno.
text.zh: 集中于 Macerata，也见于邻近 Ancona 和 Ascoli Piceno。

text.en: Mid-late budbreak and ripening; vigorous, high and regular yielding, with compact bunches.
text.zh: 萌芽与成熟中晚，生长势强、高产稳定，果串紧密。

text.en: Suitable for white-wine production; good acidity and floral character support local varietal expressions.
text.zh: 用于白葡萄酒，良好酸度及花香支持当地单品种风格。

text.en: Floral, citrus and fresh-fruit tones; VCR481 also records aromatic-herb notes.
text.zh: 花香、柑橘及鲜果；VCR481 另有芳香草本。

text.en: Limited cold resistance; susceptible to downy and powdery mildew.
text.zh: 抗寒能力较弱，对霜霉及白粉病敏感。

text.en: Adapted to temperate Marche coastal conditions, including relatively infertile soils.
text.zh: 适应 Marche 沿海温带条件，也可种于较贫瘠土壤。

grapes.summary: 为托斯卡纳红酒混酿增加厚度及陈年潜力。
grapes.viticulture: 中等生长势及产量；果串中大、金字塔形，半紧密至紧密。
grapes.winemaking: 传统上与 Chianti 其他品种混酿，以强化结构。
grapes.taste: 果肉风味中性；主要贡献酒体和结构。
grapes.confusions: 圆形且浅裂的叶片是形态识别特征，并非亲缘结论。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Old Tuscan grape rediscovered in Chianti vineyards.
text.zh: 托斯卡纳古老品种，在 Chianti 葡萄园重新受到关注。

text.en: Medium vigour and productivity; medium to large pyramidal, semi-compact to compact bunches.
text.zh: 中等生长势及产量；果串中大、金字塔形，半紧密至紧密。

text.en: Traditionally blended with other Chianti varieties to reinforce structure.
text.zh: 传统上与 Chianti 其他品种混酿，以强化结构。

text.en: Neutral berry flavour; wines contribute body and robustness rather than Muscat-like perfume.
text.zh: 果肉风味中性；主要贡献酒体和结构。

text.en: Orbicular, medium-sized leaves, entire or only slightly lobed.
text.zh: 叶片中等、近圆形，全缘或仅浅裂。

text.en: Medium slightly obovoid berries; blue, heavily bloomed skins.
text.zh: 果粒中等、微倒卵形；蓝色果皮且果粉浓厚。

grapes.summary: 深色红葡萄，可兼具酒精度、酸度及细致单宁。
grapes.viticulture: 果串小短、形似拳头；果粒中等，蓝黑果皮厚且坚韧。
grapes.winemaking: 用于红酒，特点为深色、良好酸度及较高酒精潜力。
grapes.taste: 浓郁宝石红带紫调，轻微草本，口感充实、酸度良好、单宁细致。
grapes.confusions: 小果串解释其名称，不能据此认定与其他相似葡萄的亲缘。

text.en: Old Tuscan black grape of uncertain exact origin.
text.zh: 托斯卡纳古老黑葡萄，确切起源未定。

text.en: Small, short, fist-like pyramidal bunches; medium berries with thick, leathery blue-black skins.
text.zh: 果串小短、形似拳头；果粒中等，蓝黑果皮厚且坚韧。

text.en: Red-wine production exploits its high colour, good acidity and substantial alcohol potential.
text.zh: 用于红酒，特点为深色、良好酸度及较高酒精潜力。

text.en: Intense ruby-violet colour, slight herbaceousness, full palate, good acidity and fine tannins.
text.zh: 浓郁宝石红带紫调，轻微草本，口感充实、酸度良好、单宁细致。

text.en: Colourless, juicy and firm pulp; VCR records herbaceous and pepper-like berry flavours.
text.zh: 果肉无色、多汁而结实；VCR 记录草本及椒类果实风味。

text.en: Medium pentagonal, five-lobed leaf with a closed petiolar sinus.
text.zh: 中等五角形、五裂叶片，叶柄窦闭合。

grapes.origin: 长期栽培于 Lazio 丘陵；东地中海起源属于传统推测。
grapes.summary: 亦称 Malvasia Puntinata，是 Frascati 重要混酿品种，贡献细致香气及酒体。
grapes.viticulture: 萌芽晚、成熟中晚；生长势中等、产量有时不稳，偏好向阳丘陵。
grapes.winemaking: 常与 Trebbiano 类及其他 Malvasia 混酿，也可单酿。

text.en: Long cultivated in the hills of Lazio; an eastern Mediterranean origin is traditional rather than demonstrated.
text.zh: 长期栽培于 Lazio 丘陵；东地中海起源属于传统推测。

text.en: Late budbreak, mid-late maturity; moderate vigour and sometimes irregular yields. Prefers well-exposed hills.
text.zh: 萌芽晚、成熟中晚；生长势中等、产量有时不稳，偏好向阳丘陵。

text.en: Frequently blended with Trebbiani and other Malvasias; also made as a varietal white.
text.zh: 常与 Trebbiano 类及其他 Malvasia 混酿，也可单酿。

text.en: Pale straw, mildly aromatic, rounded and moderately alcoholic, with savoury persistence.
text.zh: 浅稻草色、微芳香、口感圆润，酒精度适中而余味鲜美。

text.en: Medium-large, truncated conical and winged; berries have firm skins.
text.zh: 果串中大、截锥形且带翼，果皮坚实。

text.en: Frascati rules group it with Malvasia Bianca di Candia for the principal white component.
text.zh: Frascati 规范将其与 Malvasia Bianca di Candia 合并计入主要白葡萄组。

text.en: Used for regional reds, including Piglio blends with Cesanese d’Affile.

text.en: Ruby becoming garnet; delicate floral-fruit aromas and a soft, slightly bitter finish.
text.zh: 宝石红陈年转石榴色；细致花果香、柔和而微苦收尾。

text.en: Sensitive to fungal disease, particularly downy mildew; coulure can occur.
text.zh: 对真菌病、尤其霜霉敏感，也可能落花落果。

text.en: Medium oval berries with thick blue-violet skins.
text.zh: 果粒中等椭圆，果皮厚、蓝紫色。

text.en: Medium-large berries, firm purple-black skins, nearly colourless juice.
text.zh: 果粒中大、皮坚实紫黑，果汁近乎无色。

grapes.viticulture: 萌芽中晚、成熟中等；高产稳定、生长势中等、耐旱良好。
grapes.winemaking: 常用于混酿；中长梢修剪及广适应性有利于生产。
grapes.taste: 深稻草色、香气含蓄、鲜美并略带苦味。

text.en: Long established in Lazio and Campania; the conventional Greek-origin narrative does not establish a precise pedigree.
text.zh: 长期分布于 Lazio 与 Campania；传统希腊起源说不能确定具体谱系。

text.en: Mid-late budbreak, medium maturity; consistent high yield, moderate vigour and good drought tolerance.
text.zh: 萌芽中晚、成熟中等；高产稳定、生长势中等、耐旱良好。

text.en: Commonly blended; medium-long pruning and broad adaptability make it commercially useful.
text.zh: 常用于混酿；中长梢修剪及广适应性有利于生产。

text.en: Deep straw, discreet fragrance, savoury and mildly bitter finish.
text.zh: 深稻草色、香气含蓄、鲜美并略带苦味。

text.en: Large, winged, relatively loose bunches; thin but firm golden-yellow skins.
text.zh: 果串大、带翼且相对疏松；金黄果皮薄但坚实。

text.en: Adapts to many soil types when conditions are warm; tolerates winter cold and late frost reasonably well.
text.zh: 温暖条件下可适应多类土壤；对冬季低温及晚霜有较好耐性。

grapes.viticulture: 生长势中高、产量较高稳定；宜开展整形及中长梢修剪。
grapes.winemaking: 用于 Cori Nero Buono 单品种及地方红酒混酿。

text.en: Centred on Cori in Latina; documented in the 1883 agricultural inquiry.

text.en: Medium-high vigour, fairly high regular yields; expanded systems and medium-long pruning.
text.zh: 生长势中高、产量较高稳定；宜开展整形及中长梢修剪。

text.en: Varietal Cori Nero Buono and regional red blends.
text.zh: 用于 Cori Nero Buono 单品种及地方红酒混酿。

text.en: Intense red, good alcohol, vinous aroma and harmonious palate.
text.zh: 红色浓郁，酒精度良好，葡萄酒香明确、口感协调。

text.en: Compact to very compact bunches can suffer sour rot in wet years.
text.zh: 紧密至极紧密果串在多雨年份可受酸腐病影响。

text.en: Medium-thick blue-black skin; firm pulp.
text.zh: 果皮中厚、蓝黑，果肉较结实。

grapes.origin: Spoleto 谷地及 Montefalco 传统葡萄，Francolini 于1908年记载。
grapes.summary: 独立的翁布里亚高酸白葡萄，成熟晚、酿造风格广。
grapes.viticulture: 生长势强、皮坚韧；采收从9月底延至10月，有时至11月初。
grapes.winemaking: 可酿静态、起泡、风干甜及浸皮风格；酸度支持陈年。
grapes.taste: 柑橘型酸度、成熟果味及饱满度；酿法与熟成可带出芳香草本层次。
grapes.confusions: Trebbiano Toscano 不同；古代 Spoleto 酒不能自动对应现代此品种。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Traditional grape of the Spoleto valley and Montefalco; documented by Francolini in 1908.
text.zh: Spoleto 谷地及 Montefalco 传统葡萄，Francolini 于1908年记载。

text.en: Vigorous with tough skins; harvest from late September through October, sometimes early November.
text.zh: 生长势强、皮坚韧；采收从9月底延至10月，有时至11月初。

text.en: Still, sparkling, passito and skin-contact interpretations occur; acidity supports ageing.
text.zh: 可酿静态、起泡、风干甜及浸皮风格；酸度支持陈年。

text.en: Citrus-driven acidity, ripe fruit and volume; more balsamic nuances develop with style and maturity.
text.zh: 柑橘型酸度、成熟果味及饱满度；酿法与熟成可带出芳香草本层次。

text.en: Old vines survive trained to maple, elm and ash; modern hill plantings use trellises.
text.zh: 老藤仍可见攀附枫、榆、梣树，现代丘陵多采用棚架行栽。

text.en: Cool humid plain sites may ripen later than better-exposed slopes.
text.zh: 凉湿平原地块可能较向阳坡地更晚成熟。

grapes.origin: Bruno Bruni 于1930年代在 Marche 的杂交计划中育成。
grapes.summary: 欧洲种杂交，结合花草香及 Verdicchio 相关的结构表现。
grapes.viticulture: Terra Argillosa 常于8月下旬、早于其其他品种采收；这是具体地块观察。
grapes.winemaking: A Ida 采用轻柔压榨、不锈钢发酵并在细酒泥上熟成数月。
grapes.taste: 清新芬芳白酒风格，花果香突出。
grapes.confusions: 为 Vitis vinifera 种内杂交，并非种间杂交。

genetics.note: Sauvignon Blanc × Verdicchio，Bruno Bruni 人工杂交。

text.en: Bred by Bruno Bruni in Marche during his 1930s crossing programme.
text.zh: Bruno Bruni 于1930年代在 Marche 的杂交计划中育成。

text.en: Terra Argillosa harvests it before its other grapes, often in late August; this is a site observation.
text.zh: Terra Argillosa 常于8月下旬、早于其其他品种采收；这是具体地块观察。

text.en: A Ida is gently pressed, fermented in steel and held on fine lees for several months.
text.zh: A Ida 采用轻柔压榨、不锈钢发酵并在细酒泥上熟成数月。

text.en: Fresh, fragrant white style with pronounced floral-fruit aromas.
text.zh: 清新芬芳白酒风格，花果香突出。

text.en: Sauvignon Blanc × Verdicchio.
text.zh: Sauvignon Blanc × Verdicchio。

text.en: Terra Argillosa harvests during cool hours and chills fruit on arrival.
text.zh: Terra Argillosa 在较凉时段采收，并在入厂后冷却果实。

grapes.origin: Todi 附近恢复的稀有翁布里亚葡萄；十九世纪有文献，2011年国家登记。
grapes.summary: 经保育后重新用于单品种红酒。
grapes.viticulture: Bettalunga 观察其果串较松、皮厚且耐病性有利。
grapes.winemaking: Bettalunga 于2019年换接，2020年获得恢复地块的首批收成。
grapes.taste: 酒庄记录其多酚高、年轻单宁相对柔顺。
grapes.confusions: 地方 Greco Nero 名称不能把 Todi 材料与南意大利所有同名品种合并。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Rare Umbrian grape recovered near Todi; nineteenth-century documentation and national registration in 2011.
text.zh: Todi 附近恢复的稀有翁布里亚葡萄；十九世纪有文献，2011年国家登记。

text.en: Bettalunga observes relatively loose bunches, thick skins and useful disease tolerance.
text.zh: Bettalunga 观察其果串较松、皮厚且耐病性有利。

text.en: Bettalunga regrafted vines in 2019 and harvested the renewed Grero plot in 2020.
text.zh: Bettalunga 于2019年换接，2020年获得恢复地块的首批收成。

text.en: The estate reports high polyphenols with comparatively supple early tannins.
text.zh: 酒庄记录其多酚高、年轻单宁相对柔顺。

text.en: A surviving old mother vine was identified in Todi in 2009.
text.zh: 2009年在 Todi 发现存活的古老母株。

text.en: Bettalunga’s plot is at 250 m, with clay, pebbles and sandy veins in heterogeneous hill soils.
text.zh: Bettalunga 地块海拔250米，丘陵土含黏土、卵石及砂层。

grapes.origin: AMAP 记录其分布于 Ancona 与 Macerata，并在 Petritoli 保存。
grapes.summary: 稀有地方白葡萄，亦称 Garofalata，现重新用于单品种装瓶。
grapes.viticulture: 生长势中低、芽眼结实率良好、产量中等；萌芽比 Trebbiano Toscano 早数天，成熟大致同期。
grapes.winemaking: Terracruda 将其酿成名为 Innominata 的 Marche IGT 单品种白酒。
grapes.taste: 葡萄汁酸度高、糖分良好；山楂花、柑橘及青苹果，酒体中等清新。
grapes.confusions: 历史上与 Moscato 相联系的描述不能确定异名或完整谱系。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Marche variety recorded by AMAP in Ancona and Macerata and conserved at Petritoli.
text.zh: AMAP 记录其分布于 Ancona 与 Macerata，并在 Petritoli 保存。

text.en: Moderate-low vigour, good bud fertility and medium yields; budbreak precedes Trebbiano Toscano by a few days, while maturity is broadly contemporary.
text.zh: 生长势中低、芽眼结实率良好、产量中等；萌芽比 Trebbiano Toscano 早数天，成熟大致同期。

text.en: Terracruda produces a varietal Marche IGT white called Innominata.
text.zh: Terracruda 将其酿成名为 Innominata 的 Marche IGT 单品种白酒。

text.en: High must acidity and good sugar; hawthorn, citrus and green apple, with fresh medium-bodied wines.
text.zh: 葡萄汁酸度高、糖分良好；山楂花、柑橘及青苹果，酒体中等清新。

text.en: Entered the regional repertoire on 6 December 2007 as resource 42.
text.zh: 2007年12月6日进入地区资源名录，编号42。

text.en: Innominata demonstrates a varietal wine under Marche IGT.
text.zh: Innominata 展示 Marche IGT 下的单品种酿造。

text.en: The studied Petrignone accessions match Garofanata genetically; Pampanone remains unconfirmed.
text.zh: 所研究 Petrignone 材料与 Garofanata 遗传匹配；Pampanone 尚未确认。

grapes.origin: 与 Massa-Carrara 有关，1874年已记录 Massaretta 异名。
grapes.summary: 深色、高酚托斯卡纳红葡萄，可单酿或与 Sangiovese 混酿。
grapes.viticulture: 生长势强、芽眼结实率低；萌芽近 Sangiovese，成熟常早7至10天。
grapes.winemaking: 为混酿增加颜色与清新度，单酿试验得到结构型红酒。
grapes.taste: 深宝石红、口感饱满，清新植物气息及可能较强的单宁。
grapes.confusions: Massaretta 为比萨大学 VitisDB 支持的异名。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Associated with Massa-Carrara; documented in 1874 with the synonym Massaretta.
text.zh: 与 Massa-Carrara 有关，1874年已记录 Massaretta 异名。

text.en: Vigorous with low bud fertility; budbreak similar to Sangiovese, ripening often 7–10 days earlier.
text.zh: 生长势强、芽眼结实率低；萌芽近 Sangiovese，成熟常早7至10天。

text.en: Adds colour and freshness to blends; varietal trials give substantial reds.
text.zh: 为混酿增加颜色与清新度，单酿试验得到结构型红酒。

text.en: Deep ruby, full palate, fresh vegetal notes and potentially firm tannin.
text.zh: 深宝石红、口感饱满，清新植物气息及可能较强的单宁。

text.en: Spring frost can be damaging; powdery mildew is a particular susceptibility.
text.zh: 春霜可能造成严重损害，尤其易受白粉病影响。

text.en: High anthocyanin and total polyphenol levels are reported.
text.zh: 研究记录较高花色苷及总多酚。

grapes.origin: 托斯卡纳北部红葡萄，栽培于 Fosdinovo 及 Carrara 周边。
grapes.summary: 地方红葡萄，Terenzuola 的 Toscana IGT 酒为实证。
grapes.viticulture: Terenzuola 采用 Guyot，在9月下半月按地块成熟度分别手工采收。
grapes.winemaking: 酒庄在混凝土中发酵、人工压帽，并在混凝土中酒泥熟成。
grapes.taste: 已记录酒款为干红，其品鉴表现属于包含5% Pollera 的混酿。
grapes.confusions: 与白色 Vermentino 共名不足以证明颜色突变关系。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Northern Tuscan red cultivated around Fosdinovo and Carrara.
text.zh: 托斯卡纳北部红葡萄，栽培于 Fosdinovo 及 Carrara 周边。

text.en: Terenzuola uses Guyot and hand harvests parcels separately in the second half of September.
text.zh: Terenzuola 采用 Guyot，在9月下半月按地块成熟度分别手工采收。

text.en: The estate ferments in concrete with manual punch-downs and ages on fine lees in concrete.
text.zh: 酒庄在混凝土中发酵、人工压帽，并在混凝土中酒泥熟成。

text.en: The documented wine is a dry red; its tasting profile is a blend expression, including 5% Pollera.
text.zh: 已记录酒款为干红，其品鉴表现属于包含5% Pollera 的混酿。

text.en: Terenzuola’s reference wine contains 95% Vermentino Nero and 5% Pollera.
text.zh: Terenzuola 代表酒为95% Vermentino Nero 与5% Pollera。

text.en: Estate densities are 8,000–11,000 vines/ha with yield at or below 1.2 kg/vine.
text.zh: 酒庄密度为每公顷8,000至11,000株，每株产量不超过1.2公斤。

grapes.origin: Lunigiana 与 Colli di Luni 地方红葡萄。
grapes.summary: 当地传统混酿葡萄，贡献清新度。
grapes.viticulture: 实际见于 Liguria–Toscana 边界沿海丘陵；普遍物候仍待进一步核实。
grapes.winemaking: Lunae 的 Niccolò V 将其与 Sangiovese、Merlot 混酿，再用大橡木桶熟成。
grapes.taste: Lunae 特别将清新度归于 Pollera；整酒果香与木香不能视为品种诊断特征。
grapes.confusions: Pollera 为地方简称；混酿描述不能当作单品种试验。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Local red of Lunigiana and the Colli di Luni area.
text.zh: Lunigiana 与 Colli di Luni 地方红葡萄。

text.en: Lunae’s Niccolò V blends Pollera Nera with Sangiovese and Merlot, then matures in large oak.
text.zh: Lunae 的 Niccolò V 将其与 Sangiovese、Merlot 混酿，再用大橡木桶熟成。

text.en: Lunae attributes freshness specifically to Pollera; the whole wine’s fruit and oak notes are not varietal diagnostic markers.
text.zh: Lunae 特别将清新度归于 Pollera；整酒果香与木香不能视为品种诊断特征。

text.en: Niccolò V spends 12 months in 20–30 hl oak and six months in bottle.
text.zh: Niccolò V 在20至30百升橡木桶12个月，瓶陈6个月。

text.en: The estate reports 12 days on skins for this blend.

grapes.origin: 尤其与 Macerata 的 Serrapetrona 有关，当地红酒酿造可追溯至十五世纪。
grapes.summary: Vernaccia di Serrapetrona 起泡红酒及 Serrapetrona 静态红酒的核心葡萄。
grapes.viticulture: 代表葡萄园位于约400至700米高丘，土壤有泥灰岩石灰岩及砂岩黏土差异。
grapes.winemaking: 起泡 DOCG 先分别发酵鲜葡萄与风干葡萄，再于压力罐中起泡发酵。
grapes.taste: 红黑水果、紫罗兰及香料；风干与甜度显著影响结构。
grapes.confusions: Vernaccia 属历史名称群，不能据此与 Vernaccia di San Gimignano 视为同一。

genetics.note: 本次核查的来源未确定完整双亲。

text.en: Associated especially with Serrapetrona in Macerata; local red vinification is documented from the fifteenth century.
text.zh: 尤其与 Macerata 的 Serrapetrona 有关，当地红酒酿造可追溯至十五世纪。

text.en: Reference vineyards lie on high hills around 400–700 m, with marl-limestone and sandstone-clay variation.
text.zh: 代表葡萄园位于约400至700米高丘，土壤有泥灰岩石灰岩及砂岩黏土差异。

text.en: For the sparkling DOCG, fresh and dried-grape fermentations precede pressure-tank refermentation.
text.zh: 起泡 DOCG 先分别发酵鲜葡萄与风干葡萄，再于压力罐中起泡发酵。

text.en: Red and dark fruit, violet and spice; drying and sweetness level materially change structure.
text.zh: 红黑水果、紫罗兰及香料；风干与甜度显著影响结构。

text.en: Both dry and sweet sparkling versions are represented.

intro.en: Extensive Tuscan Sangiovese denomination, legally separate from Chianti Classico; the 2026 amendment adds rosé and revises red composition.
intro.zh: 广域托斯卡纳 Sangiovese 产区，与 Chianti Classico 法律上独立；2026修订新增桃红并调整红酒配方。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: Red, Riserva, Superiore and, under the 2026 amendment, Rosé.
body.zh: 红酒、Riserva、Superiore，以及2026修订下的 Rosé。

body.en: Chianti Classico is a separate DOCG, not a Chianti subzone.
body.zh: Chianti Classico 是独立 DOCG，并非 Chianti 子区。

body.en: Defined areas in Arezzo, Firenze, Pisa, Pistoia, Prato and Siena provinces.
body.zh: 涵盖 Arezzo、Firenze、Pisa、Pistoia、Prato、Siena 各省划定地区。

body.en: Colli Aretini, Colli Fiorentini, Colli Senesi, Colline Pisane, Montalbano, Montespertoli, Rufina and Terre di Vinci.
body.zh: 子区为 Colli Aretini、Colli Fiorentini、Colli Senesi、Colline Pisane、Montalbano、Montespertoli、Rufina、Terre di Vinci。

body.en: Sangiovese 60–100%; white grapes up to 10%.
body.zh: Sangiovese 60–100%；白葡萄最多10%。

body.en: Cabernet Sauvignon plus Cabernet Franc at most 15%; Colli Senesi at most 10%.
body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 与 Cabernet Franc 合计最多15%；Colli Senesi 最多10%。

body.en: Minimum 60% Sangiovese under the new Rosé rules.
body.zh: 新桃红规则要求至少60% Sangiovese。

body.en: The decree applies from the 2026/27 harvest campaign. The former 70% red minimum remains relevant to earlier bottles.
body.zh: 法令自2026/27收获季适用；旧有红酒70%最低比例仍与更早年份酒有关。

body.en: A specific provision allows qualifying 2025 wine to be reclassified as Rosé; it is not a general retroactive red-wine change.
body.zh: 专门条文允许合资格2025酒改列 Rosé，不代表红酒配方普遍追溯变更。

body.en: The traditional renewed-fermentation practice is allowed for red, not Rosé.
body.zh: 传统再发酵方法允许用于红酒，不允许用于 Rosé。

body.en: At least two years ageing, counted from 1 January after harvest.
body.zh: 至少陈年两年，自采收后1月1日起算。

body.en: From 1 March after harvest; subzone and type rules may delay release.
body.zh: 采收后3月1日起，部分子区及酒型更晚。

body.en: Colli Fiorentini and Montespertoli: 1 June; Rufina, Superiore and Terre di Vinci: 1 September.
body.zh: Colli Fiorentini、Montespertoli 为6月1日；Rufina、Superiore、Terre di Vinci 为9月1日。

body.en: From 1 December of the harvest year.
body.zh: 采收当年12月1日起。

role.zh: 主体葡萄，最低比例须按年份判断。

role.en: Possible white component within the red-wine ceiling.
role.zh: 红酒白葡萄限额内可用组分。

sources.title: Chianti — consolidated 2026 specification and effective campaign decree

intro.en: Hill-country Sangiovese between Florence and Siena, with Annata, Riserva and Gran Selezione tiers.
intro.zh: Florence 与 Siena 之间的丘陵 Sangiovese 产区，分 Annata、Riserva、Gran Selezione。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: Separate DOCG from Chianti since 1996.
body.zh: 1996年以来与 Chianti 分为独立 DOCG。

body.en: The Gallo Nero identifies the consortium’s wines.
body.zh: Gallo Nero 黑公鸡为协会酒款标志。

body.en: Greve, Radda, Gaiole and Castellina are central municipalities.
body.zh: Greve、Radda、Gaiole、Castellina 是核心市镇。

body.en: Eleven: San Casciano, Greve, Montefioralle, Lamole, Panzano, Radda, Gaiole, Castellina, San Donato in Poggio, Vagliagli and Castelnuovo Berardenga.
body.zh: 11个：San Casciano、Greve、Montefioralle、Lamole、Panzano、Radda、Gaiole、Castellina、San Donato in Poggio、Vagliagli、Castelnuovo Berardenga。

body.en: At least 80% Sangiovese; only red complementary grapes.
body.zh: 至少80% Sangiovese，仅允许红色辅助葡萄。

body.en: From vintage 2027, at least 90% Sangiovese, with the remaining maximum 10% from specified indigenous reds.
body.zh: 2027年份起，至少90% Sangiovese，其余最多10%来自规定本土红葡萄。

body.en: The UGA scheme applies to Gran Selezione.
body.zh: UGA 制度适用于 Gran Selezione。

body.en: Gran Selezione uses grapes from vineyards managed by the bottling estate.
body.zh: Gran Selezione 使用装瓶酒庄直接管理葡萄园的果实。

body.en: Release from 1 October after harvest.
body.zh: 采收次年10月1日起上市。

body.en: At least 24 months, including three in bottle.
body.zh: 至少24个月，包括3个月瓶陈。

body.en: At least 30 months, including three in bottle.
body.zh: 至少30个月，包括3个月瓶陈。

body.en: Do not apply the 2027 90% rule automatically to a 2026 Gran Selezione.
body.zh: 不能把2027起90%规则自动套用于2026 Gran Selezione。

body.en: Chianti Classico excludes white grapes, unlike the limited allowance in Chianti red.
body.zh: Chianti Classico 不允许白葡萄，而 Chianti 红酒有有限许可。

sources.title: Chianti Classico consortium — UGA and 2027 composition transition

intro.en: Long-aged Sangiovese from the municipality of Montalcino; Brunello is a local grape name.
intro.zh: Montalcino 市镇的长陈年 Sangiovese；Brunello 是地方葡萄名称。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: 100% Sangiovese, locally Brunello.
body.zh: 100% Sangiovese，当地称 Brunello。

body.en: DOC in 1966; DOCG in 1980.
body.zh: 1966年 DOC，1980年 DOCG。

body.en: The delimited Montalcino area in Siena province, southern inland Tuscany.
body.zh: Siena 省 Montalcino 划定范围，位于托斯卡纳内陆南部。

body.en: A hill landscape with varied exposures; Monte Amiata influences protection from weather to the southeast.
body.zh: 丘陵朝向多样，东南方向 Monte Amiata 影响气候屏障。

body.en: Sangiovese alone; neither Cabernet nor Merlot is permitted in the blend.
body.zh: 只用 Sangiovese，配方不允许 Cabernet 或 Merlot。

body.en: The base specification ceiling is 8 t/ha; annual measures may reduce operational yields.
body.zh: 基础规范上限每公顷8吨，年度措施可能下调实际限额。

body.en: 1 January of the fifth year after the harvest year; Riserva in the sixth.
body.zh: 采收年份之后第5年的1月1日；Riserva 为第6年。

body.en: A 2021 Brunello can be released in 2026; a 2021 Riserva in 2027.
body.zh: 2021 Brunello 最早2026年上市；2021 Riserva 最早2027年。

body.en: At least two years in oak.
body.zh: 至少2年橡木熟成。

body.en: At least four months in bottle; six for Riserva.
body.zh: 至少4个月瓶陈；Riserva 为6个月。

body.en: Assess firm tannin and acidity, bottle development and sediment before decanting.
body.zh: 醒酒前判断单宁酸度、瓶中发展及沉淀。

body.en: Roast meat, game and mushroom dishes are useful comparative pairings.
body.zh: 烤肉、野味与蘑菇菜可作为配餐比较。

role.en: Exclusive grape; Brunello is the local name.
role.zh: 唯一品种，Brunello 是地方名称。

intro.en: Earlier-release Sangiovese from Montalcino, with its own DOC rules.
intro.zh: Montalcino 较早上市的 Sangiovese，具有独立 DOC 规则。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: 100% Sangiovese, locally Brunello.
body.zh: 100% Sangiovese，当地称 Brunello。

body.en: DOC recognised in 1983.
body.zh: 1983年获 DOC。

body.en: The delimited Montalcino area in Siena province, southern inland Tuscany.
body.zh: Siena 省 Montalcino 划定范围，位于托斯卡纳内陆南部。

body.en: A hill landscape with varied exposures; Monte Amiata influences protection from weather to the southeast.
body.zh: 丘陵朝向多样，东南方向 Monte Amiata 影响气候屏障。

body.en: Sangiovese alone; neither Cabernet nor Merlot is permitted in the blend.
body.zh: 只用 Sangiovese，配方不允许 Cabernet 或 Merlot。

body.en: The base DOC specification permits up to 9 t/ha.
body.zh: 基础 DOC 规范最高每公顷9吨。

body.en: 1 September of the year after harvest.
body.zh: 采收次年9月1日。

body.en: A 2025 Rosso can be released from 1 September 2026.
body.zh: 2025 Rosso 最早2026年9月1日上市。

body.en: No mandatory oak-ageing period in the DOC specification.
body.zh: DOC 规范未强制橡木熟成期。

body.en: Styles vary by producer; the earlier release supports fresher fruit expression.
body.zh: 风格随酒庄变化，较早上市有利于鲜果表达。

body.en: Compare its fresher fruit and shorter maturation with Brunello from the same estate.
body.zh: 可与同庄 Brunello 比较鲜果感及较短熟成的影响。

body.en: Roast meat, game and mushroom dishes are useful comparative pairings.
body.zh: 烤肉、野味与蘑菇菜可作为配餐比较。

role.en: Exclusive grape; Brunello is the local name.
role.zh: 唯一品种，Brunello 是地方名称。

intro.en: Sangiovese-based red from the Tuscan town of Montepulciano; the town name is distinct from the Montepulciano grape.
intro.zh: 托斯卡纳 Montepulciano 城镇的 Sangiovese 主导红酒，地名不同于 Montepulciano 葡萄。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: DOC recognised in 1966; DOCG with the 1980 vintage.
body.zh: 1966年获 DOC，1980年份起 DOCG。

body.en: Prugnolo Gentile is the local Sangiovese name.
body.zh: Prugnolo Gentile 是当地 Sangiovese 名称。

body.en: Montepulciano municipality, excluding the Valdichiana floor.
body.zh: Montepulciano 市镇，排除 Valdichiana 谷底。

body.en: Eligible vineyards are between 250 and 600 m.
body.zh: 合资格葡萄园海拔250至600米。

body.en: At least 70% Sangiovese; other authorised Tuscan red grapes up to 30%.
body.zh: 至少70% Sangiovese，其余最多30%为托斯卡纳许可红葡萄。

body.en: At least 85% Sangiovese; Canaiolo, Ciliegiolo, Mammolo and Colorino can complete it, Colorino at most 5%.
body.zh: 至少85% Sangiovese，可搭配 Canaiolo、Ciliegiolo、Mammolo、Colorino，Colorino 最多5%。

body.en: Pieve grapes come from vineyards at least 15 years old managed by the bottling estate.
body.zh: Pieve 果实来自装瓶酒庄直接管理、树龄至少15年的葡萄园。

body.en: Pieve maximum 7 t/ha and 2.5 kg/vine.
body.zh: Pieve 每公顷最多7吨，每株最多2.5公斤。

body.en: Two years from 1 January following harvest, using one of the specification’s wood/bottle combinations.
body.zh: 采收后1月1日起2年，采用规范规定的木桶／瓶陈组合之一。

body.en: Three years, including six months in bottle.
body.zh: 3年，包括6个月瓶陈。

body.en: 36 months; first qualifying vintage 2021, first release 2025.
body.zh: 36个月；首个合资格年份2021，2025首次上市。

body.en: Pieve precedes one of twelve additional geographical units.
body.zh: Pieve 后接12个附加地理单元之一。

body.en: Vinification and compulsory ageing take place within Montepulciano municipality.
body.zh: 酿造与强制熟成在 Montepulciano 市镇内完成。

role.en: Mammolo identity in the existing grape library; Pieve complement.
role.zh: 现有品种库中的 Mammolo 身份，为 Pieve 辅助。

intro.en: Coastal Tuscan denomination centred on Castagneto Carducci, with international red grapes and a flexible white blend.
intro.zh: 托斯卡纳沿海以 Castagneto Carducci 为中心的产区，以国际红葡萄及灵活白酒配方见长。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: DOC in 1983; red wines joined the rules in 1994.
body.zh: 1983年 DOC，1994年将红酒纳入。

body.en: Bolgheri Sassicaia has its own specification and boundary.
body.zh: Bolgheri Sassicaia 有独立规范及边界。

body.en: Castagneto Carducci, Livorno province; between the Tyrrhenian Sea and inland hills.
body.zh: Livorno 省 Castagneto Carducci，位于第勒尼安海与内陆丘陵之间。

body.en: Mediterranean conditions moderated by sea influence and hill shelter.
body.zh: 地中海气候受海洋调节及丘陵屏障影响。

body.en: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Cabernet Franc may each range from 0 to 100%.
body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon、Merlot、Cabernet Franc 各可为0至100%。

body.en: Syrah and Sangiovese each up to 50%; other authorised red varieties together up to 30%.
body.zh: Syrah、Sangiovese 各最多50%；其他许可红葡萄合计最多30%。

body.en: Vermentino, Sauvignon and Viognier may each range from 0 to 100%; other authorised whites at most 40%.
body.zh: Vermentino、Sauvignon、Viognier 各可为0至100%；其他许可白葡萄最多40%。

body.en: Named Vermentino and Sauvignon require at least 85% of the named grape.
body.zh: 标示 Vermentino 或 Sauvignon 的酒至少85%为所标葡萄。

body.en: Release from 1 September after harvest.
body.zh: 采收次年9月1日起上市。

body.en: Two years from 1 January following harvest, including at least one in oak.
body.zh: 采收后1月1日起2年，其中至少1年橡木熟成。

intro.en: Precisely delimited Cabernet-led red denomination within Castagneto Carducci, distinct from Bolgheri DOC.
intro.zh: Castagneto Carducci 内精确划界、Cabernet 主导的红酒产区，与 Bolgheri DOC 独立。

body.en: DOC
body.zh: DOC

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: Red wine only.
body.zh: 只限红葡萄酒。

body.en: Independent DOC since 2013, previously a Bolgheri subzone.
body.zh: 2013年起独立 DOC，此前为 Bolgheri 子区。

body.en: A specifically bounded portion of Castagneto Carducci in Livorno.
body.zh: Livorno 省 Castagneto Carducci 中精确划定区域。

body.en: Defined sites include the Sassicaia and Castiglioncello areas; not all Bolgheri vineyards qualify.
body.zh: 边界涉及 Sassicaia 及 Castiglioncello 一带，并非所有 Bolgheri 葡萄园均合资格。

body.en: Minimum 80%.
Other authorised Tuscan red grapes up to 20%; the legal rule is broader than a producer’s usual Cabernet Franc blend.
body.zh: 其他托斯卡纳许可红葡萄最多20%；法律范围较酒庄常用 Cabernet Franc 配方更广。

body.en: Maximum 7 t/ha.
body.zh: 每公顷最多7吨。

body.en: All grapes must come from the specifically delimited DOC area.
body.zh: 所有果实须来自该 DOC 精确划定范围。

body.en: At least two years from 1 January after harvest.
body.zh: 采收后1月1日起至少2年。

body.en: At least 18 months in oak containers no larger than 225 litres.
body.zh: 至少18个月在不超过225升橡木容器中熟成。

intro.en: Dry white from the San Gimignano hills, built on the local Vernaccia grape and Pliocene sediments.
intro.zh: San Gimignano 丘陵干白，以当地 Vernaccia 葡萄及上新世沉积土为基础。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: Recognised in March 1966.
body.zh: 1966年3月获得 DOC。

body.en: Recognised in 1993; consolidated rules amended in October 2024.
body.zh: 1993年获 DOCG，现行汇编含2024年10月修订。

body.en: Hill vineyards in San Gimignano municipality, Siena.
body.zh: Siena 省 San Gimignano 市镇丘陵葡萄园。

body.en: Pliocene yellow sands, sandy clays and mixed soils; eligible vineyards no higher than 500 m.
body.zh: 上新世黄砂、砂质黏土及混合土，合资格葡萄园不高于500米。

body.en: At least 85% Vernaccia di San Gimignano.
body.zh: 至少85% Vernaccia di San Gimignano。

body.en: Sauvignon and Riesling together at most 10%; several aromatic varieties, including Incrocio Bruni 54, are excluded.
body.zh: Sauvignon 与 Riesling 合计最多10%；包括 Incrocio Bruni 54 的若干芳香品种禁止使用。

body.en: Maximum 9 t/ha; new plantings at least 4,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 每公顷最多9吨；新种植每公顷至少4,000株。

body.en: Tendone training prohibited; emergency irrigation allowed.
body.zh: 禁止 tendone 棚架，允许救急灌溉。

body.en: Riserva: at least 11 months from 1 January after harvest, with at least three months in bottle before release.
body.zh: Riserva 采收后1月1日起至少11个月，上市前至少3个月瓶陈。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 11.5% for the standard wine, 12.5% for Riserva.
body.zh: 基础酒总酒精度至少11.5%，Riserva 至少12.5%。

sources.title: Vernaccia di San Gimignano — 2024 consolidated specification

intro.en: Historic Tuscan red blending Sangiovese with a required Cabernet component, centred on Carmignano and Poggio a Caiano.
intro.zh: 历史托斯卡纳红酒，将 Sangiovese 与必需 Cabernet 组分结合，以 Carmignano、Poggio a Caiano 为中心。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Toscana
body.zh: Toscana

body.en: Carmignano was among the territories delimited by Cosimo III’s wine decree.
body.zh: Carmignano 是 Cosimo III 葡萄酒法令划界地区之一。

body.en: The local Cabernet tradition predates the modern Super Tuscan movement.
body.zh: 当地 Cabernet 传统早于现代 Super Tuscan 潮流。

body.en: Hills of Carmignano and Poggio a Caiano, Prato province.
body.zh: Prato 省 Carmignano 与 Poggio a Caiano 丘陵。

body.en: Western side of the Florence–Prato area, around the Montalbano hills.
body.zh: Florence–Prato 一带西侧，环绕 Montalbano 丘陵。

body.en: At least 50%.
Cabernet Sauvignon and/or Cabernet Franc: 10–20%.
body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 和／或 Cabernet Franc 为10–20%。

body.en: Canaiolo Nero at most 20%.
body.zh: Canaiolo Nero 最多20%。

body.en: Eligible soils derive from alberese marly limestone, Eocene clay schists and Oligocene sandstone.
body.zh: 合资格土壤源自 alberese 泥灰质石灰岩、始新世黏土片岩及渐新世砂岩。

body.en: Eligible hillside vineyards lie no higher than 400 m.
body.zh: 合资格坡地葡萄园海拔不超过400米。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 8 t/ha; maximum wine recovery 70%.
body.zh: 葡萄产量每公顷最多8吨；出酒率最多70%。

body.en: Emergency irrigation is permitted; forcing practices are prohibited.
body.zh: 允许救急灌溉；禁止催产措施。

body.en: At least eight months in oak and/or chestnut; Riserva requires at least twelve months.
body.zh: 橡木及／或栗木桶至少8个月；Riserva 至少12个月。

body.en: Vinification, compulsory ageing and bottling take place in Carmignano and Poggio a Caiano.
body.zh: 酿造、强制陈年及装瓶在 Carmignano 与 Poggio a Caiano 进行。

body.en: Standard: 1 June in the second year after harvest; Riserva: 29 September in the third year after harvest.
body.zh: 基础酒为采收后第二年的6月1日；Riserva 为采收后第三年的9月29日。

body.en: Trebbiano Toscano, Canaiolo Bianco and Malvasia del Chianti together may total up to 10%; other authorised black grapes may contribute up to 10%.
body.zh: Trebbiano Toscano、Canaiolo Bianco、Malvasia del Chianti 合计最多10%；其他许可黑葡萄最多10%。

body.en: Barco Reale di Carmignano is a separate DOC.
body.zh: Barco Reale di Carmignano 是独立 DOC。

body.en: The local rosé tradition belongs to the related Carmignano wine family, not the red DOCG type.
body.zh: 当地桃红传统属于相关 Carmignano 酒系，并非红酒 DOCG 酒型。

sources.title: Ministerial Carmignano DOCG specification — document copy

intro.en: Dry and passito wines made exclusively from Sagrantino in a small Umbrian hill area.
intro.zh: 翁布里亚小片丘陵内仅用 Sagrantino 酿造的干型及风干甜型酒。

body.en: DOCG
body.zh: DOCG

body.en: Umbria
body.zh: Umbria

body.en: DOC in 1979, DOCG in 1992.
body.zh: 1979年 DOC，1992年 DOCG。

body.en: Dry Sagrantino is documented at the 1925 Umbrian wine exhibition, alongside sweeter versions.
body.zh: 1925年翁布里亚酒展已有干型 Sagrantino，与较甜版本并列。

body.en: All Montefalco and parts of Bevagna, Gualdo Cattaneo, Castel Ritaldi and Giano dell’Umbria.

body.en: Exposed volcanic hills help attain ripeness while retaining the local white-wine profile.

body.en: Lazio
body.zh: Lazio

body.en: Piglio’s 1479 statutes provide historical evidence of the wine-growing economy.
body.zh: Piglio 1479年法规提供当地葡萄酒经济的历史证据。

body.en: DOCG; the protected alternative name is Piglio.
body.zh: DOCG，受保护替代名称为 Piglio。

body.en: Entire Piglio and Serrone.
body.zh: Piglio 与 Serrone 全境。

body.en: Delimited parts of Acuto, Anagni and Paliano, Frosinone province.
body.zh: Frosinone 省 Acuto、Anagni、Paliano 划定部分。

body.en: Cesanese d’Affile and/or Cesanese Comune at least 90%.
body.zh: Cesanese d’Affile 和／或 Cesanese Comune 合计至少90%。

body.en: The two Cesanese varieties remain separately registered.
body.zh: 两种 Cesanese 在品种登记中仍独立。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 13%.
body.zh: 总酒精度至少13%。

body.zh: 限 Superiore，至少20个月熟成，其中6个月瓶陈，总酒精度至少14%。

body.en: Well-exposed hills help Cesanese ripen; poorly exposed high sites are problematic for Comune.
body.zh: 向阳丘陵有助于成熟，高海拔且朝向差的地块对 Comune 尤其不利。

body.en: Both Cesanese varieties require attention to fungal disease; Comune also experiences coulure.
body.zh: 两者均需关注真菌病，Comune 也会落花落果。

body.zh: DOC

body.en: Lazio
body.zh: Lazio

body.zh: Bianco、Rosso，以及 Bellone、Nero Buono 品种型。

body.en: Cori is a denomination; Nero Buono is the grape often qualified “di Cori”.
body.zh: Cori 是产区，Nero Buono 为常加“di Cori”的葡萄名称。

body.en: All Cori and part of Cisterna di Latina.
body.zh: Cori 全境及 Cisterna di Latina 部分地区。

body.en: Vine-growing land ranges approximately 40–463 m.
body.zh: 葡萄种植地约40至463米。

body.en: Marine carbonate materials associated with the Lepini foothills.
body.zh: 与 Lepini 山麓相关的海相碳酸盐材料。

body.en: Hill sites are important to the local Bellone and Nero Buono tradition.
body.zh: 丘陵地块是 Bellone、Nero Buono 地方传统的重要基础。

body.zh: Bellone 至少50%、Malvasia del Lazio 至少20%、Greco 至少15%。

body.en: Minimum 50% Nero Buono, 20% Montepulciano and 15% Cesanese.
body.zh: Nero Buono 至少50%、Montepulciano 至少20%、Cesanese 至少15%。

body.en: At least 85% Bellone.
body.zh: 至少85% Bellone。

body.en: At least 85% Nero Buono.
body.zh: 至少85% Nero Buono。

intro.zh: Lazio 南部，以芳香葡萄 Moscato di Terracina 为核心。

body.zh: DOC

body.en: Lazio
body.zh: Lazio

body.en: Moscato di Terracina, historically also used as table fruit.
body.zh: Moscato di Terracina，历史上也用于鲜食。

body.en: Secco, Amabile, Passito and Spumante.
body.zh: Secco、Amabile、Passito、Spumante。

body.en: Monte San Biagio, Terracina and Sonnino.
body.zh: Monte San Biagio、Terracina、Sonnino。

body.en: Ausoni foothills near the southern Lazio coast.

body.en: Mediterranean coastal influence.
body.zh: 地中海沿海影响。

body.en: Carbonate terrain of the Ausoni system.
body.zh: Ausoni 山系碳酸盐地层。

body.zh: 至少85% Moscato di Terracina。

body.en: 100% Moscato di Terracina.
body.zh: 100% Moscato di Terracina。

body.zh: 红酒、Riserva、Superiore，以及2026修订下的 Rosé。

body.zh: Chianti Classico 是独立 DOCG，并非 Chianti 子区。

body.zh: Montepulciano 市镇，排除 Valdichiana 谷底。

label.zh: Vino Nobile di Montepulciano — 海拔

body.en: Eligible vineyards are between 250 and 600 m.
body.zh: 合资格葡萄园海拔250至600米。

body.en: Greve, Radda, Gaiole and Castellina are central municipalities.
body.zh: Greve、Radda、Gaiole、Castellina 是核心市镇。

body.en: Eleven: San Casciano, Greve, Montefioralle, Lamole, Panzano, Radda, Gaiole, Castellina, San Donato in Poggio, Vagliagli and Castelnuovo Berardenga.
body.zh: 11个：San Casciano、Greve、Montefioralle、Lamole、Panzano、Radda、Gaiole、Castellina、San Donato in Poggio、Vagliagli、Castelnuovo Berardenga。

body.en: Castagneto Carducci, Livorno province; between the Tyrrhenian Sea and inland hills.
body.zh: Livorno 省 Castagneto Carducci，位于第勒尼安海与内陆丘陵之间。

body.en: Mediterranean conditions moderated by sea influence and hill shelter.
body.zh: 地中海气候受海洋调节及丘陵屏障影响。

body.en: The delimited Montalcino area in Siena province, southern inland Tuscany.
body.zh: Siena 省 Montalcino 划定范围，位于托斯卡纳内陆南部。

body.en: A hill landscape with varied exposures; Monte Amiata influences protection from weather to the southeast.
body.zh: 丘陵朝向多样，东南方向 Monte Amiata 影响气候屏障。

body.en: Hill vineyards in San Gimignano municipality, Siena.
body.zh: Siena 省 San Gimignano 市镇丘陵葡萄园。

label.en: Vernaccia di San Gimignano — Soil and height
label.zh: Vernaccia di San Gimignano — 土壤与高度

body.en: Pliocene yellow sands, sandy clays and mixed soils; eligible vineyards no higher than 500 m.
body.zh: 上新世黄砂、砂质黏土及混合土，合资格葡萄园不高于500米。

body.en: Maximum 9 t/ha; new plantings at least 4,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 每公顷最多9吨；新种植每公顷至少4,000株。

body.zh: 禁止 tendone 棚架，允许救急灌溉。

body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 和／或 Cabernet Franc 为10–20%。

body.en: Canaiolo Nero at most 20%.
body.zh: Canaiolo Nero 最多20%。

body.en: Vermentino, Sauvignon and Viognier may each range from 0 to 100%; other authorised whites at most 40%.
body.zh: Vermentino、Sauvignon、Viognier 各可为0至100%；其他许可白葡萄最多40%。

body.en: Named Vermentino and Sauvignon require at least 85% of the named grape.
body.zh: 标示 Vermentino 或 Sauvignon 的酒至少85%为所标葡萄。

body.en: The decree applies from the 2026/27 harvest campaign. The former 70% red minimum remains relevant to earlier bottles.
body.zh: 法令自2026/27收获季适用；旧有红酒70%最低比例仍与更早年份酒有关。

body.en: A specific provision allows qualifying 2025 wine to be reclassified as Rosé; it is not a general retroactive red-wine change.
body.zh: 专门条文允许合资格2025酒改列 Rosé，不代表红酒配方普遍追溯变更。

body.en: At least 80% Sangiovese; only red complementary grapes.
body.zh: 至少80% Sangiovese，仅允许红色辅助葡萄。

body.en: From vintage 2027, at least 90% Sangiovese, with the remaining maximum 10% from specified indigenous reds.
body.zh: 2027年份起，至少90% Sangiovese，其余最多10%来自规定本土红葡萄。

body.en: At least two years in oak.
body.zh: 至少2年橡木熟成。

body.en: At least four months in bottle; six for Riserva.
body.zh: 至少4个月瓶陈；Riserva 为6个月。

body.en: Two years from 1 January following harvest, using one of the specification’s wood/bottle combinations.
body.zh: 采收后1月1日起2年，采用规范规定的木桶／瓶陈组合之一。

label.zh: Vino Nobile di Montepulciano — 珍藏

body.en: Three years, including six months in bottle.
body.zh: 3年，包括6个月瓶陈。

body.en: 36 months; first qualifying vintage 2021, first release 2025.
body.zh: 36个月；首个合资格年份2021，2025首次上市。

body.en: Massaretta in Massa-Carrara; high colour and phenolics, with particular powdery mildew sensitivity.
body.zh: Massa-Carrara 称 Massaretta，颜色及酚类高，尤其对白粉病敏感。

body.en: Barsaglina can complement Colli di Luni reds; its documented history reaches 1874.
body.zh: Barsaglina 可辅助 Colli di Luni 红酒，文献历史达1874年。

role.zh: 主体葡萄，最低比例须按年份判断。

role.en: Possible white component within the red-wine ceiling.
role.zh: 红酒白葡萄限额内可用组分。

role.en: Mammolo identity in the existing grape library; Pieve complement.
role.zh: 现有品种库中的 Mammolo 身份，为 Pieve 辅助。

role.en: A local blending grape adding substance and ageing potential to Tuscan reds.
role.zh: 为托斯卡纳红酒混酿增加厚度及陈年潜力。

role.en: A deeply coloured red variety combining alcohol, acidity and fine tannin.
role.zh: 深色红葡萄，可兼具酒精度、酸度及细致单宁。

role.en: A deeply coloured, phenolic Tuscan red useful both alone and in Sangiovese blends.
role.zh: 深色、高酚托斯卡纳红葡萄，可单酿或与 Sangiovese 混酿。

role.en: A local red variety represented by Terenzuola’s Toscana IGT bottling.
role.zh: 地方红葡萄，Terenzuola 的 Toscana IGT 酒为实证。

role.en: Traditional blending grape providing freshness in local reds.
role.zh: 当地传统混酿葡萄，贡献清新度。

note.en: 95% Vermentino Nero, 5% Pollera; concrete fermentation and lees maturation.
note.zh: 95% Vermentino Nero、5% Pollera，混凝土发酵及酒泥熟成。

note.zh: Colli di Luni Rosso：Sangiovese、Merlot、Pollera Nera；该跨区产区亦延伸至 Liguria。

q.en: Which grape is locally called Brunello?
q.zh: 当地 Brunello 指何种葡萄？

a.en: Sangiovese.

q.en: What grape is Prugnolo Gentile?
q.zh: Prugnolo Gentile 是何品种？

a.en: Sangiovese in Montepulciano.

q.en: Is Chianti Classico a Chianti subzone?
q.zh: Chianti Classico 是 Chianti 子区吗？

a.en: No; it is a separate DOCG.

q.en: Which municipality defines Vernaccia di San Gimignano?
q.zh: Vernaccia di San Gimignano 以何市镇划界？

a.en: San Gimignano, Siena province.

q.en: Where is Bolgheri located?
q.zh: Bolgheri 位于何处？

a.en: Castagneto Carducci, Livorno province, coastal Tuscany.
a.zh: 托斯卡纳沿海 Livorno 省 Castagneto Carducci。

q.en: Which variety must dominate Bolgheri Sassicaia?
q.zh: Bolgheri Sassicaia 必须以何品种为主？

a.en: Cabernet Sauvignon, minimum 80%.

q.en: Which two communes define Carmignano?
q.zh: Carmignano 由哪两个市镇构成？

a.en: Carmignano and Poggio a Caiano.

q.en: What is Massaretta?
q.zh: Massaretta 是什么？

a.en: A synonym of Barsaglina in Massa-Carrara.

q.en: Name Chianti Classico’s three tiers.
q.zh: 列出 Chianti Classico 三个等级。

a.en: Annata, Riserva and Gran Selezione.

q.en: Is Montepulciano the principal grape in Vino Nobile?
q.zh: Vino Nobile 主体葡萄是 Montepulciano 吗？

a.en: No; the town is Montepulciano, while the principal grape is Sangiovese.
a.zh: 不是，Montepulciano 为地名，主体葡萄是 Sangiovese。

q.en: When does Chianti’s 60% Sangiovese red minimum apply?
q.zh: Chianti 红酒60% Sangiovese 最低要求何时适用？

a.en: From the 2026/27 harvest campaign; older vintages retain their applicable earlier rules.
a.zh: 2026/27收获季起；旧年份仍适用其此前规则。

q.en: Does the 2025 Rosé provision change all 2025 Chianti reds?
q.zh: 2025 Rosé 条款是否改变全部2025 Chianti 红酒？

a.en: No; it is a specific qualifying reclassification provision for Rosé.
a.zh: 不是，属于符合条件的 Rosé 改列专门条款。

q.en: Which new Chianti subzone appears in the 2026 rules?
q.zh: 2026 Chianti 规则新增何子区？

a.en: Terre di Vinci.

q.en: Compare Chianti and Chianti Classico white-grape allowances.
q.zh: 比较 Chianti 与 Chianti Classico 的白葡萄许可。

a.en: Chianti red permits up to 10%; Chianti Classico permits no white grapes.
a.zh: Chianti 红酒最多10%；Chianti Classico 不允许。

q.en: When does Gran Selezione require 90% Sangiovese?
q.zh: Gran Selezione 何时要求90% Sangiovese？

a.en: From the 2027 vintage; the complementary maximum 10% is restricted to specified indigenous reds.
a.zh: 2027年份起，其余最多10%限规定本土红葡萄。

q.en: Are the eleven Chianti Classico UGAs available to Annata?
q.zh: 11个 Chianti Classico UGA 可用于 Annata 吗？

a.en: The introduced scheme is reserved to Gran Selezione.

q.en: Compare Riserva and Gran Selezione maturation.
q.zh: 比较 Riserva 与 Gran Selezione 熟成。

a.en: 24 versus 30 months, both including at least three months in bottle.
a.zh: 24与30个月，两者均含至少3个月瓶陈。

q.en: When can 2021 Brunello and its Riserva first be sold?
q.zh: 2021 Brunello 及其 Riserva 最早何时上市？

a.en: 2026 and 2027 respectively.

q.en: What are Brunello’s oak and bottle minima?
q.zh: Brunello 橡木与瓶陈最低要求？

a.en: Two years oak; four months bottle, or six for Riserva.
a.zh: 2年橡木；4个月瓶陈，Riserva 为6个月。

q.en: Must Rosso di Montalcino be oak aged?
q.zh: Rosso di Montalcino 必须橡木陈年吗？

a.en: No mandatory oak period; release may begin 1 September after harvest.
a.zh: 无强制橡木期；采收次年9月1日起可上市。

q.en: How does Vino Nobile Pieve change the grape minimum?
q.zh: Vino Nobile Pieve 如何提高品种最低比例？

a.en: Sangiovese rises from 70% to 85%; complementary grapes are restricted.
a.zh: Sangiovese 由70%提高至85%，辅助品种受限制。

q.en: What vine-age and control requirements apply to Pieve?
q.zh: Pieve 树龄与管理要求？

a.en: Vines at least 15 years old, directly managed by the bottling estate.
a.zh: 至少15年树龄，装瓶酒庄直接管理。

q.en: When did the first Pieve vintage enter the market?
q.zh: 首个 Pieve 年份何时上市？

a.en: Vintage 2021 entered in 2025, following 36 months maturation.

q.en: Can Bolgheri Rosso be 100% Cabernet Franc?
q.zh: Bolgheri Rosso 可为100% Cabernet Franc 吗？

a.en: Yes; Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon can each be 0–100%.
a.zh: 可以，Cabernet Franc、Merlot、Cabernet Sauvignon 各可为0–100%。

q.en: Must Bolgheri Bianco contain Vermentino?
q.zh: Bolgheri Bianco 必须含 Vermentino 吗？

a.en: No; Vermentino, Sauvignon and Viognier can each be 0–100%.

q.en: Contrast Bolgheri Superiore and Sassicaia oak minima.
q.zh: 比较 Bolgheri Superiore 与 Sassicaia 木桶最低要求。

a.en: Superiore: one year oak within two years total; Sassicaia: 18 months oak, containers at most 225 L, within two years total.
a.zh: Superiore 总2年内至少1年橡木；Sassicaia 总2年内至少18个月橡木，容器不超过225升。

q.en: What is distinctive about Carmignano’s Cabernet rule?
q.zh: Carmignano 的 Cabernet 规则有何特点？

a.en: Cabernet Sauvignon and/or Cabernet Franc is required at 10–20%.
a.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 和／或 Cabernet Franc 必须占10–20%。

q.en: What soils and height limit define Vernaccia vineyard eligibility?
q.zh: Vernaccia 合资格葡萄园的土壤及海拔限制？

a.en: Pliocene yellow sands and sandy clays on hills no higher than 500 m.
a.zh: 上新世黄砂及砂质黏土丘陵，不高于500米。

q.en: What is the Sauvignon/Riesling ceiling in Vernaccia di San Gimignano?
q.zh: Vernaccia di San Gimignano 中 Sauvignon／Riesling 上限？

a.en: Together at most 10%, within the overall 15% complementary allowance.
a.zh: 合计最多10%，包含在总15%辅助限额内。

q.en: How does Barsaglina differ from Sangiovese in maturity and disease risk?
q.zh: Barsaglina 与 Sangiovese 在成熟及病害风险上有何区别？

a.en: Budbreak is similar, maturity often 7–10 days earlier; powdery mildew is a particular Barsaglina risk.
a.zh: 萌芽相近，成熟常早7至10天，Barsaglina 尤需防白粉病。

body.en: Dry Sagrantino is documented at the 1925 Umbrian wine exhibition, alongside sweeter versions.
body.zh: 1925年翁布里亚酒展已有干型 Sagrantino，与较甜版本并列。

body.en: Orvieto and surrounding municipalities in Terni province.
body.zh: Terni 省 Orvieto 及周边市镇。

body.en: Includes delimited land in Viterbo: Castiglione in Teverina, Civitella d’Agliano, Graffignano, Lubriano and Bagnoregio.
body.zh: 包括 Viterbo 的 Castiglione in Teverina、Civitella d’Agliano、Graffignano、Lubriano、Bagnoregio 划定土地。

body.en: All Montefalco and parts of Bevagna, Gualdo Cattaneo, Castel Ritaldi and Giano dell’Umbria.
body.zh: Montefalco 全境及 Bevagna、Gualdo Cattaneo、Castel Ritaldi、Giano dell’Umbria 部分地区。

body.en: All are in Perugia, central Umbria.
body.zh: 均在翁布里亚中部 Perugia 省。

body.en: All Montefalco and parts of Campello sul Clitunno, Castel Ritaldi, Foligno, Spoleto and Trevi.
body.zh: Montefalco 全境及 Campello sul Clitunno、Castel Ritaldi、Foligno、Spoleto、Trevi 部分地区。

body.en: Plains alternate with low hills, entirely in Perugia province.
body.zh: 平原与低丘交替，全部位于 Perugia 省。

body.en: Tree-trained old vines survive in the valley.
body.zh: 谷地仍有攀树老藤。

body.en: Cooler humid plains can ripen later than exposed slopes.
body.zh: 凉湿平原成熟可能晚于向阳坡地。

body.en: Trebbiano Toscano (Procanico) and Grechetto together at least 60%.
body.zh: Trebbiano Toscano（Procanico）与 Grechetto 合计至少60%。

body.en: Other authorised white varieties up to 40%.
body.zh: 其他许可白葡萄最多40%。

body.en: 10–25%; other authorised reds 0–30%.
Minimum 50% Trebbiano Spoletino.
body.zh: 至少50% Trebbiano Spoletino。

body.en: Minimum 85% Grechetto.
body.zh: 至少85% Grechetto。

body.en: Minimum 50% Trebbiano Spoletino.
body.zh: 至少50% Trebbiano Spoletino。

body.en: At least 85% Trebbiano Spoletino.
body.zh: 至少85% Trebbiano Spoletino。

body.en: 33 months from 1 December of the harvest year.
body.zh: 采收当年12月1日起33个月。

body.en: At least four further months in bottle: minimum total 37 months, not 33 including bottle.
body.zh: 其后至少另加4个月瓶陈，总计至少37个月，并非33个月内含瓶陈。

body.en: Secco, Abboccato, Amabile and Dolce are covered.
body.zh: 涵盖 Secco、Abboccato、Amabile、Dolce。

body.en: Vendemmia Tardiva is reserved to Superiore, including Classico Superiore.
body.zh: Vendemmia Tardiva 限 Superiore，包括 Classico Superiore。

body.en: Secco requires at least 12 months in oak, with no specified barrel size.
body.zh: Secco 至少12个月橡木熟成，未限定桶容量。

body.en: No identical mandatory oak period is imposed on Passito.
body.zh: Passito 不适用相同强制橡木期限。

body.en: The 2023 consolidated specification gives 80–180 g/L residual sugar and minimum 18% total alcohol.
body.zh: 2023汇编规范规定残糖80–180克／升、总酒精度至少18%。

body.en: High natural acidity supports sparkling base wines.
body.zh: 高天然酸度支持起泡基酒。

body.en: Slow ripening with acid retention permits concentration without losing all freshness.
body.zh: 缓慢成熟并保酸，使浓缩后仍可保持清新感。

body.en: At least three months in bottle are required.
body.zh: 要求至少3个月瓶陈。

body.en: Rare red recovered near Todi; national registration in 2011 followed identification of surviving old material.
body.zh: Todi 附近恢复的稀有红葡萄，发现存活老株后于2011年国家登记。

body.en: Bettalunga reports loose bunches, thick skins and early supple tannins from its restored plot.
body.zh: Bettalunga 在恢复地块记录疏松果串、厚皮及年轻柔顺单宁。

role.zh: Procanico，与 Grechetto 合计最低比例。

role.en: A conservation success now returning to varietal red production.
role.zh: 经保育后重新用于单品种红酒。

q.en: Which grape exclusively makes Montefalco Sagrantino?
q.zh: Montefalco Sagrantino 只用何葡萄？

a.en: Sagrantino.

q.en: Which grape leads Montefalco Rosso?
q.zh: Montefalco Rosso 以何葡萄为主？

a.en: Sangiovese.

q.en: Which white grape defines Spoleto DOC?
q.zh: Spoleto DOC 以何白葡萄为核心？

a.en: Trebbiano Spoletino.

q.en: Which two regions share Orvieto DOC?
q.zh: Orvieto DOC 跨哪两个大区？

a.en: Umbria and Lazio.

q.en: What is Procanico?
q.zh: Procanico 是什么？

a.en: The local name for Trebbiano Toscano.

q.en: Which province contains Montefalco?
q.zh: Montefalco 位于何省？

a.en: Perugia.

q.en: What are the two Sagrantino DOCG styles?
q.zh: Sagrantino DOCG 的两种酒型？

a.en: Secco and Passito.

q.en: Where was Grero recovered?
q.zh: Grero 在何处恢复？

a.en: Near Todi.

q.en: Is Trebbiano Spoletino identical to Trebbiano Toscano?
q.zh: Trebbiano Spoletino 与 Trebbiano Toscano 相同吗？

a.en: No; they are distinct varieties.

q.en: What does Orvieto Classico identify?
q.zh: Orvieto Classico 指什么？

a.en: The delimited historical subzone.

q.en: Calculate Sagrantino’s minimum maturation including bottle.
q.zh: 计入瓶陈后 Sagrantino 最低熟成多久？

a.en: 33 months plus four additional months in bottle, at least 37 months.
a.zh: 33个月另加4个月瓶陈，至少37个月。

q.en: When does Sagrantino’s 33-month clock start?
q.zh: Sagrantino 33个月从何时起算？

a.en: 1 December of the harvest year.

q.en: Does Passito share Secco’s mandatory oak rule?
q.zh: Passito 与 Secco 的强制木桶规则相同吗？

a.en: No; Secco requires 12 months oak; Passito does not have that identical requirement.
a.zh: 不同，Secco 要求12个月橡木，Passito 无相同要求。

q.en: What is the Passito residual-sugar range in the 2023 text?
q.zh: 2023规范中 Passito 残糖范围？

q.en: What is Sagrantino Passito’s minimum total alcohol?
q.zh: Sagrantino Passito 最低总酒精度？

a.en: 18%; total includes potential alcohol from residual sugar.

q.en: What evidence challenges the idea that dry Sagrantino is entirely recent?
q.zh: 何证据说明干型 Sagrantino 并非全新现象？

a.en: Dry and sweeter Sagrantino were documented at the 1925 Umbrian wine exhibition.
a.zh: 1925年翁布里亚酒展同时记载干型及较甜 Sagrantino。

q.en: Give Montefalco Rosso’s complete grape ranges.
q.zh: 列出 Montefalco Rosso 品种比例范围。

a.en: Sangiovese 60–80%, Sagrantino 10–25%, other authorised reds 0–30%.

q.en: What is Montefalco Bianco’s principal-grape minimum?
q.zh: Montefalco Bianco 主体葡萄最低比例？

a.en: 50% Trebbiano Spoletino.

q.en: What is Montefalco Grechetto’s minimum grape content?
q.zh: Montefalco Grechetto 最低品种含量？

a.en: 85% Grechetto.

q.en: Contrast Spoleto Bianco and named Trebbiano Spoletino.
q.zh: 比较 Spoleto Bianco 与品种型 Trebbiano Spoletino。

a.en: Bianco needs 50%; named styles need 85% Trebbiano Spoletino.
a.zh: Bianco 至少50%；品种型至少85% Trebbiano Spoletino。

q.en: Why can valley-floor Spoletino ripen later than hill fruit?
q.zh: 为何谷底 Spoletino 可能晚于坡地成熟？

a.en: The plains can be cooler and more humid, while exposed slopes reach sugar maturity sooner.
a.zh: 平原更凉湿，向阳坡地更早达到糖成熟。

q.en: Which trees traditionally supported Spoletino vines?
q.zh: 传统 Spoletino 葡萄藤攀附哪些树？

a.en: Maple, elm and ash.

q.en: How late may Spoletino harvest extend?
q.zh: Spoletino 采收可晚至何时？

a.en: Through October, occasionally early November, depending on site and management.
a.zh: 视地块及管理可延至10月，偶至11月初。

q.en: Why does Spoletino suit both sparkling and passito?
q.zh: 为何 Spoletino 同时适合起泡与风干甜酒？

a.en: High retained acidity supports sparkling freshness and balances concentration in passito.
a.zh: 保留的高酸度支持起泡清新感，并平衡甜酒浓缩。

q.en: Name the five Montefalco-area communes.
q.zh: 列出 Montefalco 区五个市镇。

a.en: Montefalco, Bevagna, Gualdo Cattaneo, Castel Ritaldi and Giano dell’Umbria.

q.en: Does Spoleto DOC include only Spoleto municipality?
q.zh: Spoleto DOC 只包括 Spoleto 市镇吗？

a.en: No; it includes all Montefalco and parts of five other communes, including Spoleto.
a.zh: 不是，含 Montefalco 全境及包括 Spoleto 的另外5个市镇部分地区。

q.en: How is Orvieto’s 60% minimum calculated?
q.zh: Orvieto 60%最低比例如何计算？

a.en: Trebbiano Toscano/Procanico plus Grechetto combined, not 60% each.
a.zh: Trebbiano Toscano／Procanico 与 Grechetto 合计，并非各60%。

q.en: Can ordinary Orvieto claim Vendemmia Tardiva without Superiore?
q.zh: 普通 Orvieto 可不带 Superiore 而标晚收吗？

a.en: No; Vendemmia Tardiva is restricted to Superiore, including Classico Superiore.
a.zh: 不可以，晚收限 Superiore，包括 Classico Superiore。

q.en: Which Lazio province participates in Orvieto?
q.zh: Lazio 哪一省属于 Orvieto？

a.en: Viterbo.

q.en: When was Grero entered in the national register?
q.zh: Grero 何时进入国家品种登记？

a.en: 2011, after recovery and characterisation of old surviving vines.
a.zh: 2011年，在恢复与鉴定存活老藤之后。

intro.en: Adriatic and Apennine influences define a region of Verdicchio, Pecorino and Passerina whites, aromatic Lacrima and Vernaccia Nera reds, and Montepulciano-led southern wines.
intro.zh: 亚得里亚海与亚平宁山共同塑造地区：白酒有 Verdicchio、Pecorino、Passerina；红酒有芳香 Lacrima、Vernaccia Nera 及南部 Montepulciano 主导酒款。

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Administrative region; individual DOC/DOCG boundaries are separate.
body.zh: 行政大区；各 DOC／DOCG 边界另行划定。

body.en: Pecorino, Passerina and Rosso.
body.zh: Pecorino、Passerina、Rosso。

body.en: Terre di Offida DOC is separate and covers other traditional styles.
body.zh: Terre di Offida DOC 独立，涵盖其他传统酒型。

label.en: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — Category
label.zh: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — 类别

body.en: DOC covering still white, sparkling and passito expressions.
body.zh: 涵盖静态白、起泡及风干甜型的 DOC。

label.en: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — Classico
label.zh: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — Classico

body.en: Geographical designation for the historical production area.
body.zh: 历史生产区的地理标示。

body.en: Documents record Verdicchio cultivation at Matelica in 1579.
body.zh: 文献记录1579年 Matelica 已栽培 Verdicchio。

label.zh: Verdicchio di Matelica — 独立珍藏

body.en: Verdicchio di Matelica Riserva is a separate DOCG.
body.zh: Verdicchio di Matelica Riserva 为独立 DOCG。

label.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — 认定

body.en: DOC recognised in 1985.
body.zh: 1985年获 DOC。

label.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — 酒型

body.en: Standard, Superiore and Passito.
body.zh: 基础、Superiore、Passito。

body.en: The valley runs north–south, parallel to the Adriatic coast.
body.zh: 谷地南北走向，与亚得里亚海岸平行。

body.en: Includes parts of Matelica, Esanatoglia, Gagliole, Castelraimondo, Camerino, Pioraco, Cerreto d’Esi and Fabriano.
body.zh: 包括 Matelica、Esanatoglia、Gagliole、Castelraimondo、Camerino、Pioraco、Cerreto d’Esi、Fabriano 部分地区。

body.en: Piceno hills of southern Marche around Offida and Ripatransone.
body.zh: Marche 南部 Offida、Ripatransone 周边 Piceno 丘陵。

body.en: Between the Adriatic coast and inland hill country.
body.zh: 位于亚得里亚海岸与内陆丘陵之间。

body.en: Apennines to the west, Monte San Vicino to the east.
body.zh: 西为亚平宁山，东为 Monte San Vicino。

body.en: Cold winters, hot summers and substantial day–night differences; ripening is slowed.
body.zh: 冬冷夏热、昼夜温差大，成熟进程较慢。

label.en: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — Maritime influence
label.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — 海洋影响

body.en: Sea proximity moderates temperature variation.
body.zh: 近海位置调节温差。

label.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — 土壤

body.en: Clay-rich mixed soils and sandy zones create site variation.
body.zh: 富黏土混合土及砂质带形成地块差异。

label.en: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — Inland
label.zh: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — 内陆

body.en: Marl-clay and limestone nearer the Apennines.
body.zh: 近亚平宁山地为泥灰岩黏土与石灰岩。

label.en: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — Toward coast
label.zh: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi — 近海

body.en: More mixed, sandy and sandstone-bearing soils; maritime breezes moderate exposed hills.
body.zh: 更接近混合、砂质及含砂岩土，海风调节开放丘陵。

body.en: More silt and mixed texture toward Cerreto.
body.zh: Cerreto 方向较多粉砂与混合质地。

body.en: Marl-limestone around Matelica and whiter calcareous soils toward Castelraimondo.
body.zh: Matelica 周边泥灰岩石灰岩，往 Castelraimondo 更偏白色钙质土。

body.en: At least 85% Pecorino.
body.zh: 至少85% Pecorino。

body.en: At least 85% Passerina.
body.zh: 至少85% Passerina。

body.en: Minimum 85%.

label.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — 辅助

body.en: Up to 15% other authorised non-aromatic black grapes.
body.zh: 其他许可非芳香黑葡萄最多15%。

body.en: Earlier maturity and moderate, sometimes irregular yields.
body.zh: 成熟较早、产量中等且有时不稳定。

body.en: Later maturity, greater vigour and more regular abundant yields.
body.zh: 成熟较晚、生长势更强、丰产较稳定。

label.en: Castelli di Jesi Verdicchio Riserva — Expression
label.zh: Castelli di Jesi Verdicchio Riserva — 表现

body.en: Riserva targets greater concentration and bottle development.
body.zh: Riserva 注重更高浓度及瓶中发展。

label.en: Castelli di Jesi Verdicchio Riserva — Ageing
label.zh: Castelli di Jesi Verdicchio Riserva — 熟成

body.en: Minimum 18 months, including six in bottle.
body.zh: 至少18个月，包括6个月瓶陈。

label.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — 香气

body.en: Rose, violet and red/dark berries; youth can show firm tannin and fresh acidity.
body.zh: 玫瑰、紫罗兰及红黑浆果；年轻时可有较强单宁及清新酸度。

label.en: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — Superiore and Passito
label.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba — Superiore 与 Passito

body.en: Riper fruit and concentration shift the balance toward richer fruit and spice.
body.zh: 较熟果实与浓缩使风格偏向更浓果味及香料。

body.en: Garofalata and genetically matched Petrignone are relevant names; Pampanone remains unconfirmed in the regional study.
body.zh: Garofalata 及遗传匹配的 Petrignone 为相关名称，地区研究对 Pampanone 尚未确认。

body.en: Vernaccia di Serrapetrona sparkling red combines fresh-grape, dried-grape and pressure-tank fermentations.
body.zh: Vernaccia di Serrapetrona 起泡红酒结合鲜葡萄、风干葡萄及压力罐发酵。

role.en: The local white grape known as Ribona, important in Colli Maceratesi.
role.zh: 当地称 Ribona，是 Colli Maceratesi 的重要白葡萄。

role.en: A vinifera cross combining floral-herbal aromas with the structure associated with Verdicchio.
role.zh: 欧洲种杂交，结合花草香及 Verdicchio 相关的结构表现。

role.en: Rare local white variety, also called Garofalata, revived in modern varietal bottlings.
role.zh: 稀有地方白葡萄，亦称 Garofalata，现重新用于单品种装瓶。

role.en: The central grape of Vernaccia di Serrapetrona sparkling red and Serrapetrona still red.
role.zh: Vernaccia di Serrapetrona 起泡红酒及 Serrapetrona 静态红酒的核心葡萄。

note.en: Marche Incrocio Bruni 54 IGT; steel fermentation and fine lees.
note.zh: Marche Incrocio Bruni 54 IGT，不锈钢发酵及细酒泥熟成。

q.en: Which grape defines Jesi and Matelica white wines?
q.zh: Jesi 与 Matelica 白酒的核心葡萄？

a.en: Verdicchio.

q.en: Which sea borders Marche?
q.zh: Marche 濒临何海？

a.en: The Adriatic.

q.en: Which two named white grapes appear in Offida DOCG?
q.zh: Offida DOCG 有哪两种品种型白酒？

a.en: Pecorino and Passerina.

q.en: Which grape dominates Offida Rosso?
q.zh: Offida Rosso 的主体葡萄？

a.en: Montepulciano, at least 85%.

q.en: Which grape gives Morro d’Alba its aromatic red?
q.zh: 何葡萄酿出 Morro d’Alba 芳香红酒？

a.en: Lacrima.

q.en: What is the principal grape of Vernaccia di Serrapetrona?
q.zh: Vernaccia di Serrapetrona 主体葡萄？

a.en: Vernaccia Nera.

q.en: What is Garofalata?
q.zh: Garofalata 是什么？

a.en: A synonym of Garofanata.

q.en: Which mountain blocks sea influence in Matelica?
q.zh: 何山阻挡 Matelica 海洋影响？

a.en: Monte San Vicino to the east.

q.en: Is Lacrima di Morro d’Alba a DOC or DOCG?
q.zh: Lacrima di Morro d’Alba 是 DOC 还是 DOCG？

a.en: DOC, recognised in 1985.

q.en: Is Castelli di Jesi Verdicchio Riserva a DOCG?
q.zh: Castelli di Jesi Verdicchio Riserva 是 DOCG 吗？

a.en: Yes, separate from the broader Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi DOC.
a.zh: 是，与较广的 Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi DOC 独立。

q.en: How does Matelica’s valley orientation differ from most coastal Marche valleys?
q.zh: Matelica 谷地走向与多数沿海谷地有何不同？

a.en: It runs north–south parallel to the sea, behind a mountain barrier.
a.zh: 南北走向与海岸平行，位于山脉屏障后。

q.en: What climatic effects follow Matelica’s inland enclosure?
q.zh: Matelica 内陆封闭地形产生何气候影响？

a.en: More continental conditions, cold winters, hot summers and large diurnal shifts.
a.zh: 更强大陆性，冬冷夏热且昼夜温差大。

q.en: Compare Jesi soils near the coast and Apennines.
q.zh: 比较 Jesi 近海与近亚平宁山土壤。

a.en: Coastal areas are sandier and mixed; inland slopes have more marl-clay and limestone.
a.zh: 近海较砂质及混合，内陆坡地较多泥灰岩黏土和石灰岩。

q.en: What is Verdicchio’s minimum in both Jesi and Matelica DOCs?
q.zh: Jesi 与 Matelica DOC 的 Verdicchio 最低比例？

a.en: 85%, with up to 15% authorised whites.

q.en: Give Jesi Riserva’s ageing minimum and starting date.
q.zh: Jesi Riserva 最低熟成及起算日？

a.en: 18 months including six in bottle, from 1 December of the harvest year.
a.zh: 18个月含6个月瓶陈，自采收当年12月1日起。

q.en: Is enrichment permitted for Jesi Riserva in the 2025 consolidated text?
q.zh: 2025汇编规范允许 Jesi Riserva 增糖吗？

a.en: No; enrichment is prohibited.

q.en: Can an Offida Pecorino contain 80% Pecorino?
q.zh: Offida Pecorino 可仅含80% Pecorino 吗？

a.en: No; the minimum is 85%.

q.en: How do Pecorino and Passerina differ in ripening?
q.zh: Pecorino 与 Passerina 成熟期如何不同？

a.en: Pecorino is early; Passerina late.

q.en: Compare their typical vigour and cropping.
q.zh: 比较两者典型生长势及产量。

a.en: Pecorino: medium-low vigour and moderate irregular crops; Passerina: vigorous, abundant and regular.
a.zh: Pecorino 中低生长势、适中且不稳产；Passerina 强势、丰产稳定。

q.en: Which of these two grapes has thick skins in VCR’s description?
q.zh: VCR 描述两者中哪一种皮厚？

a.en: Passerina; Pecorino has thin skins of medium consistency.

q.en: Why is Offida Rosso not a Tuscan wine despite Montepulciano?
q.zh: 为何 Offida Rosso 虽有 Montepulciano 却非托斯卡纳酒？

a.en: Montepulciano is its grape; the denomination lies in southern Marche.
a.zh: Montepulciano 为葡萄，产区位于 Marche 南部。

q.en: What causes the “tears” associated with Lacrima?
q.zh: Lacrima 所称“泪滴”如何产生？

a.en: Ripe berry skins can split and release drops of juice.
a.zh: 成熟果皮可能裂开、渗出果汁滴。

q.en: Which rivers frame Lacrima’s growing area?
q.zh: 哪两条河构成 Lacrima 地区的南北框架？

a.en: Cesano to the north and Esino to the south.

q.en: What is Lacrima’s minimum and the complementary restriction?
q.zh: Lacrima 最低比例与辅助限制？

a.en: 85% Lacrima; at most 15% authorised non-aromatic black grapes.
a.zh: 85% Lacrima，其他许可非芳香黑葡萄最多15%。

q.en: Describe the three fermentations of Vernaccia di Serrapetrona.
q.zh: 描述 Vernaccia di Serrapetrona 的三次发酵。

a.en: Fresh grapes, naturally dried grapes, then tank refermentation for sparkling pressure.
a.zh: 鲜葡萄发酵、自然风干葡萄发酵、最后罐内起泡再发酵。

q.en: Is Vernaccia di Serrapetrona always sweet?
q.zh: Vernaccia di Serrapetrona 是否都为甜型？

a.en: No; both dry and sweet sparkling versions exist.
a.zh: 不是，有干型及甜型起泡酒。

q.en: What is Vernaccia Nera’s minimum for the DOCG?
q.zh: 该 DOCG 的 Vernaccia Nera 最低比例？

q.en: Which Garofanata synonym has molecular support in AMAP’s study?
q.zh: AMAP 研究中何 Garofanata 异名有分子支持？

a.en: Petrignone; Pampanone remains unconfirmed.

q.en: How does Garofanata compare with Trebbiano Toscano phenologically?
q.zh: Garofanata 与 Trebbiano Toscano 物候如何比较？

a.en: Budbreak is a few days earlier, while maturity is broadly contemporary in the trial.
a.zh: 试验中萌芽早数天，成熟期大致相当。

q.en: What structure and aromas did Garofanata trials identify?
q.zh: Garofanata 试验记录何结构与香气？

a.en: High must acidity, good sugar, hawthorn, citrus and green apple; medium-bodied fresh wines.
a.zh: 葡萄汁酸度高、糖分良好，山楂花、柑橘及青苹果；酒体中等清新。

intro.en: Volcanic Castelli Romani whites, Cesanese from the eastern hills, Cori’s Bellone and Nero Buono, and Terracina’s aromatic wines form distinct regional traditions.
intro.zh: 火山 Castelli Romani 白酒、东部丘陵 Cesanese、Cori 的 Bellone 与 Nero Buono、Terracina 芳香酒构成不同地方传统。

body.zh: 行政大区；各 DOC／DOCG 边界另行划定。

body.zh: 1966年获 DOC。

body.en: Frascati DOC, Frascati Superiore DOCG and Cannellino di Frascati DOCG are distinct legal entries.
body.zh: Frascati DOC、Frascati Superiore DOCG、Cannellino di Frascati DOCG 为不同法律条目。

body.en: Piglio’s 1479 statutes provide historical evidence of the wine-growing economy.
body.zh: Piglio 1479年法规提供当地葡萄酒经济的历史证据。

body.en: DOCG; the protected alternative name is Piglio.
body.zh: DOCG，受保护替代名称为 Piglio。

body.en: Frascati, Grottaferrata and Monte Porzio Catone, with parts of Rome and Montecompatri.
body.zh: Frascati、Grottaferrata、Monte Porzio Catone 全境，以及 Rome、Montecompatri 部分地区。

body.en: Alban Hills southeast of Rome.
body.zh: Rome 东南的 Alban Hills。

label.zh: Cesanese del Piglio — 核心市镇

body.en: Entire Piglio and Serrone.
body.zh: Piglio 与 Serrone 全境。

body.en: Delimited parts of Acuto, Anagni and Paliano, Frosinone province.
body.zh: Frosinone 省 Acuto、Anagni、Paliano 划定部分。

body.en: Monte San Biagio, Terracina and Sonnino.
body.zh: Monte San Biagio、Terracina、Sonnino。

body.en: Ausoni foothills near the southern Lazio coast.
body.zh: Lazio 南部近海的 Ausoni 山麓。

body.en: Mediterranean coastal influence.
body.zh: 地中海沿海影响。

body.en: Carbonate terrain of the Ausoni system.
body.zh: Ausoni 山系碳酸盐地层。

body.en: Permeable volcanic soils: well drained, dry but not arid.
body.zh: 通透火山土，排水良好、干爽但不干旱。

body.en: The zone rises from lower slopes toward roughly 500 m.
body.zh: 产区由较低坡地上升至约500米。

body.en: Marine carbonate materials associated with the Lepini foothills.
body.zh: 与 Lepini 山麓相关的海相碳酸盐材料。

body.en: Hill sites are important to the local Bellone and Nero Buono tradition.
body.zh: 丘陵地块是 Bellone、Nero Buono 地方传统的重要基础。

body.en: Malvasia Bianca di Candia and/or Malvasia del Lazio together at least 70%.
body.zh: Malvasia Bianca di Candia 和／或 Malvasia del Lazio 合计至少70%。

body.en: Bellone, Bombino Bianco, Greco, Trebbiano Toscano and Trebbiano Giallo: up to 30%.
body.zh: Bellone、Bombino Bianco、Greco、Trebbiano Toscano、Trebbiano Giallo 合计最多30%。

body.en: Minimum 50% Bellone, 20% Malvasia del Lazio and 15% Greco.
body.zh: Bellone 至少50%、Malvasia del Lazio 至少20%、Greco 至少15%。

body.en: Minimum 50% Nero Buono, 20% Montepulciano and 15% Cesanese.
body.zh: Nero Buono 至少50%、Montepulciano 至少20%、Cesanese 至少15%。

body.en: Well-exposed hills help Cesanese ripen; poorly exposed high sites are problematic for Comune.
body.zh: 向阳丘陵有助于成熟，高海拔且朝向差的地块对 Comune 尤其不利。

body.en: Both Cesanese varieties require attention to fungal disease; Comune also experiences coulure.
body.zh: 两者均需关注真菌病，Comune 也会落花落果。

body.en: Alberello survives locally; compact bunches require rot management.
body.zh: 当地仍有 alberello 杯状整形，紧密果串需防腐烂。

body.en: Drying intensifies Muscat aroma and moves colour toward gold and amber.
body.zh: 风干强化麝香葡萄香，颜色趋金黄琥珀。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12%; Riserva 13%.
body.zh: 总酒精度至少12%；Riserva 13%。

body.en: At least 12 months from 1 November of harvest year, including three months in bottle.
body.zh: 采收当年11月1日起至少12个月，内含3个月瓶陈。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 13%.
body.zh: 总酒精度至少13%。

body.en: Reserved to Superiore with at least 20 months ageing, including six in bottle, and minimum total alcohol 14%.
body.zh: 限 Superiore，至少20个月熟成，其中6个月瓶陈，总酒精度至少14%。

body.en: Minimum residual sugar 35 g/L.
body.zh: 残糖至少35克／升。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12.5%; total includes potential alcohol from residual sugar.
body.zh: 总酒精度至少12.5%，总量包含残糖潜在酒精。

body.en: Late harvest is required; partial drying is permitted.
body.zh: 要求晚收，允许部分风干。

body.en: Enrichment is prohibited.
body.zh: 禁止增糖。

body.en: Maturano, Capolongo and Pampanaro survive in the southern Lazio heritage; Pampanaro corresponds to Bello, not Bellone.
body.zh: Maturano、Capolongo、Pampanaro 属 Lazio 南部传统；Pampanaro 对应 Bello，并非 Bellone。

body.en: Reale Bianca is distinct from Reale Gialla/Capolongo; Raspato Nero is locally Olivella di Esperia.
body.zh: Reale Bianca 不同于 Reale Gialla／Capolongo；Raspato Nero 当地称 Olivella di Esperia。

body.en: Rosciola is a pink-skinned local grape with high acidity and sparkling potential.
body.zh: Rosciola 为粉红果皮地方葡萄，酸度高且适合起泡。

role.zh: 主体葡萄，Spumante 唯一品种。

role.en: Rare southern Lazio white for still and sparkling wines.
role.zh: Lazio 南部稀有白葡萄，可酿静态及起泡酒。

role.en: A local Lazio red with plum-shaped berries and floral-fruit expression.
role.zh: Lazio 地方红葡萄，果粒似李子，具花果香。

role.en: Southern Lazio white giving fruit-driven wines with useful acidity.
role.zh: Lazio 南部白葡萄，酒款以果味和良好酸度见长。

role.en: Late-ripening southern Lazio red generally used with other local varieties.
role.zh: Lazio 南部晚熟红葡萄，通常与当地其他品种混酿。

role.en: A productive local white with floral fruit and substantial acidity.
role.zh: 高产地方白葡萄，具花果香及扎实酸度。

role.en: Local Lazio red commonly vinified alone, combining floral aromas and balanced acidity.
role.zh: 常单酿的 Lazio 地方红葡萄，兼具花香及平衡酸度。

role.en: Vigorous local white giving full, relatively low-acid wines.
role.zh: 生长势强的地方白葡萄，酒体较足、酸度较低。

role.en: Pink-skinned dual-purpose grape with strong potential for sparkling rosé.
role.zh: 粉红果皮、鲜食酿酒兼用，适合起泡桃红。

role.en: Historic Lazio red capable of structured wines and ageing.
role.zh: Lazio 历史红葡萄，可酿结构型及可陈年酒款。

q.en: Name Lazio’s three DOCGs.
q.zh: 列出 Lazio 三个 DOCG。

a.en: Cesanese del Piglio, Frascati Superiore and Cannellino di Frascati.
a.zh: Cesanese del Piglio、Frascati Superiore、Cannellino di Frascati。

q.en: Which two Malvasias form the Frascati core?
q.zh: Frascati 核心是哪两种 Malvasia？

a.en: Malvasia Bianca di Candia and Malvasia del Lazio.
a.zh: Malvasia Bianca di Candia 与 Malvasia del Lazio。

q.en: What is Malvasia Puntinata?
q.zh: Malvasia Puntinata 是什么？

a.en: Malvasia del Lazio.

q.en: Which white grape is also Cacchione?
q.zh: 何白葡萄亦称 Cacchione？

a.en: Bellone.

q.en: Where is Nero Buono historically centred?
q.zh: Nero Buono 历史中心在哪？

a.en: Cori, Latina province.

q.en: Which grape defines Terracina DOC?
q.zh: Terracina DOC 核心葡萄？

a.en: Moscato di Terracina.

q.en: What colour is Rosciola’s skin?
q.zh: Rosciola 果皮何色？

a.en: Pink.

q.en: What is Rossetto?
q.zh: Rossetto 是什么？

a.en: A synonym of Trebbiano Giallo.

q.en: Which two Cesanese varieties are registered separately?
q.zh: 哪两种 Cesanese 独立登记？

a.en: Cesanese Comune and Cesanese d’Affile.

q.en: What is Cannellino di Frascati’s style?
q.zh: Cannellino di Frascati 为何风格？

a.en: Sweet late-harvest white.

q.en: When were the two Frascati DOCGs approved?
q.zh: 两个 Frascati DOCG 何时批准？

a.en: 20 September 2011.

q.en: Give the Frascati principal-grape threshold.
q.zh: Frascati 主体葡萄最低比例？

a.en: The two Malvasias together must be at least 70%.
a.zh: 两种 Malvasia 合计至少70%。

q.en: Name the five principal secondary grapes in Frascati.
q.zh: 列出 Frascati 五种主要辅助葡萄。

a.en: Bellone, Bombino Bianco, Greco, Trebbiano Toscano and Trebbiano Giallo.

q.en: How is the “other white varieties” allowance expressed in the DOCG rules?
q.zh: DOCG 对其他白葡萄限额如何表述？

a.en: At most 15% of the 30% secondary group, not an additional unrestricted 15% of the wine.
a.zh: 最多为30%辅助组的15%，并非酒中额外不受限15%。

q.en: Compare Frascati Superiore and Riserva alcohol minima.
q.zh: 比较 Frascati Superiore 与 Riserva 最低酒精度。

a.en: Minimum total alcohol 12% versus 13%.

q.en: What is Frascati Superiore Riserva’s ageing clock?
q.zh: Frascati Superiore Riserva 陈年如何计时？

a.en: 12 months from 1 November of harvest year, including three in bottle.
a.zh: 采收当年11月1日起12个月，包括3个月瓶陈。

q.en: What residual sugar and total alcohol does Cannellino require?
q.zh: Cannellino 要求何残糖与总酒精度？

a.en: At least 35 g/L residual sugar and 12.5% total alcohol.
a.zh: 残糖至少35克／升，总酒精度至少12.5%。

q.en: Can Cannellino be enriched or partially dried?
q.zh: Cannellino 可以增糖或部分风干吗？

a.en: Enrichment is prohibited; partial grape drying is allowed after late harvest.
a.zh: 禁止增糖；晚收后允许部分风干。

q.en: Name the complete municipalities shared by the Frascati DOCGs.
q.zh: 列出 Frascati DOCG 纳入全境的市镇。

a.en: Frascati, Grottaferrata and Monte Porzio Catone; Rome and Montecompatri are partial.
a.zh: Frascati、Grottaferrata、Monte Porzio Catone；Rome、Montecompatri 只纳部分。

q.en: What distinguishes Frascati’s soil framework from Cori’s?
q.zh: Frascati 与 Cori 土壤框架有何区别？

a.en: Frascati is volcanic; Cori includes marine carbonate material of the Lepini foothills.
a.zh: Frascati 为火山土；Cori 有 Lepini 山麓海相碳酸盐材料。

q.en: What is Piglio’s minimum Cesanese proportion?
q.zh: Piglio 最低 Cesanese 比例？

a.en: 90% combined Comune and/or d’Affile.
a.zh: Comune 和／或 d’Affile 合计90%。

q.en: Name Piglio’s five communes and distinguish complete from partial.
q.zh: 列出 Piglio 五市镇并区分全境与部分。

a.en: Piglio and Serrone complete; Acuto, Anagni and Paliano partial.

q.en: What additional requirements distinguish Piglio Riserva?
q.zh: Piglio Riserva 有何附加要求？

a.en: It is Superiore with at least 20 months maturation, six in bottle, and 14% minimum total alcohol.
a.zh: 须为 Superiore，至少20个月熟成含6个月瓶陈，总酒精度至少14%。

q.en: How do named Cori Bellone and Nero Buono differ from blended Cori types?
q.zh: Cori 品种型与混酿型有何不同？

a.en: Named Bellone and Nero Buono each require 85%; Bianco and Rosso have multi-grape formulas.
a.zh: 品种型各至少85%；Bianco、Rosso 采用多品种配方。

q.en: Give Cori Bianco’s three required grape minima.
q.zh: 列出 Cori Bianco 三种必需葡萄最低比例。

a.en: Bellone 50%, Malvasia del Lazio 20%, Greco 15%.

q.en: Give Cori Rosso’s three required grape minima.
q.zh: 列出 Cori Rosso 三种必需葡萄最低比例。

a.en: Nero Buono 50%, Montepulciano 20%, Cesanese 15%.

q.en: How does Terracina Spumante differ in grape minimum?
q.zh: Terracina Spumante 品种最低比例有何不同？

a.en: 100% Moscato di Terracina, compared with 85% for the other named types.
a.zh: 100% Moscato di Terracina，其他酒型最低85%。

q.en: Is Pampanaro’s confirmed Bello synonym the same as Bellone?
q.zh: Pampanaro 已确认的 Bello 异名等于 Bellone 吗？

a.en: No; Bello corresponds to Pampanaro, while Bellone remains separate.
a.zh: 不等，Bello 对应 Pampanaro，Bellone 独立。

q.en: Distinguish Reale Bianca and Reale Gialla.
q.zh: 区分 Reale Bianca 与 Reale Gialla。

a.en: Reale Bianca is separate; Reale Gialla is the local Capolongo name.
a.zh: Reale Bianca 独立；Reale Gialla 为 Capolongo 地方名。

q.en: Why does Rosciola suit sparkling wine?
q.zh: 为何 Rosciola 适合起泡酒？

a.en: High acidity and low tannin support a fresh pink sparkling style.
a.zh: 高酸低单宁支持清新粉红起泡风格。
